101	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
102	
103	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
104	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
105	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
106	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
107	
108	noncomputable section

110	/-! ## The split witness predicate at a class over a field -/
111	
112	variable (C) in
113	/-- **The split witness predicate** (CHART-U(a) in the `w4-datb` §1.6 (a-amendment)
114	spelling), at a plus class `μ` over a field `K`.
115	
116	A plus class over a field need not be an honest Čech class — it is `PicEtAff.mk E x` for
117	an étale cover `E` of `K`.  The amendment's "for some finite separable `L/κ(t)` splitting
118	the collapsed plus class" is this: there is a finite separable extension `L/K` over which
119	`μ` becomes `relPicMk` of an honest Čech class `M` on `C_L`, and `M` admits an effective
120	witness divisor with vanishing `H¹`.
121	
122	Stated with the witness clause on a *presenting Čech class* rather than on a datum,
123	because the datum layer is where the shifted-datum constructor (DAT-C GAP-1) is missing;
124	the two agree through `Pic0ChartLocusClass.mem_cechWitnessLocus_iff_exists`.
125	
126	## A convention this predicate INHERITS, and which a consumer must not misread
127	
128	The worksheets say "effective degree-`g` witness with `h¹ = 0`".  The witness clause here —
129	and the tree's `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing`
130	(`Pic0ChartLocusFibreField.lean:115`) that it mirrors, and the GAP-6 dictionary
131	`subsingleton_h1_tensor_iff_exists_witness` (`DivisorFamilyH1Locus.lean:182`) that both rest
132	on — asks for **neither `0 ≤ W` nor `deg W = g`**.  It asks only for a `CurveDivisor` in the
133	class with vanishing `H¹`.  That is deliberate on the tree's side: the dictionary is an *iff*
134	against the engine's complex-form condition `Subsingleton (H¹(pair D) ⊗ L)`, and that
135	condition cannot see effectivity or degree, so adding either clause would break the iff and
136	with it the openness route.
137	
138	Two consequences, both load-bearing:
139	
140	* the degree is supplied **externally**, by the chart-index constraint through
141	  `degAt_chartTwist` below: on a degree-zero `λ` the twisted class has fibre degree
142	  `m·d₁ − deg Z`, which the constraint `deg Z = m·d₁ − g` makes `+g`.  It is *not* a
143	  hypothesis of this predicate.  (Until 2026-07-28 this read `−g`, and that sign made the
144	  locus empty for every `g ≥ 1` — see `degAt_chartTwist` and issue I-0514;
145	  `chartTwist_chartValue` now pins the direction by the kernel);
146	* effectivity likewise is not asserted here.  Where the *worksheet's* stronger reading is
147	  actually needed — the canonical-section normalization `h⁰ = 1`, and GAP-2 uniqueness
148	  (`Scheme.CurveDivisor.eq_of_picClass_eq_of_h0_one`, which does take `0 ≤ D`, `0 ≤ D'`) — the
149	  effectivity must be re-supplied at that point.  A lane that reads `IsSplitWitness` as
150	  already giving it will have a gap where it least expects one. -/
151	def IsSplitWitness {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
152	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K)) : Prop :=
153	  ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra K L)
154	      (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L) (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
155	      (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic),
156	    PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ)
157	        = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M)
158	      ∧ ∃ W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor,
159	          Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M
160	            ∧ Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
161	                ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1)
162	
163	/-! ## The twisted fibre family -/
164	
165	variable (C) in
166	/-- **The twisted family whose chart-membership `chartLocus` tests**: the plus class `λ`
167	shifted by the Σ-family of `Z` and by `m` inverse powers of the pinned θ-family.
168	
169	This is the *class-side* half of `chartValue` (`Picard/DivSchemeAbel.lean:351`): where
170	`chartValue` twists the Abel class of a divisor family, `chartTwist` twists an arbitrary
171	plus class by the same two factors.  A point of `chartLocus` is precisely a point at which
172	`chartTwist` is realised by an effective divisor with no `H¹` — i.e. at which `λ` itself is
173	a chart value, after undoing the twist. -/
174	def chartTwist (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
175	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T) : picEt C T :=
176	  lam * (thetaFamily C (thetaCechClass C) T ^ m) * (sigmaFamily C Z T)⁻¹
177	
178	/-- **The degree ledger of the twist**: at every field point the twisted family has fibre
179	degree `m·d₁ − deg Z` when `λ` is degree-zero.  With the chart-index constraint
180	`deg Z = m·d₁ − g` this is `+g`, which is the degree at which an effective witness with
181	`h¹ = 0` can exist at all.
182	
183	**Sign discipline, and it was wrong here until 2026-07-28 (issue I-0514).**  `chartTwist`
184	must be the INVERSE of `chartValue`'s twist, not the same one.  `chartValue` is
185	`abelDiv · Σ · (θᵐ)⁻¹` (`DivSchemeAbel.lean:351`), so recovering the Abel class from a chart
186	value means multiplying by `θᵐ` and dividing by `Σ` — hence `chartTwist` is
187	`λ · θᵐ · Σ⁻¹`.  An earlier version applied the `chartValue` twist itself, giving fibre degree
188	`deg Z − m·d₁ = −g`; since `Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(W))` forces `deg W ≥ g − 1`, that locus was
189	**empty for every `g ≥ 1`** and its openness was the openness of `∅`.  The comparison point is
190	`degAt_chartValue` at `n = g` (where the chart index is calibrated and `chartValue` lands in
191	`pic0`), NOT at `n = 0`.
192	
193	**An independent confirmation that `+g` is the right target**, worth recording because the
194	wrong sign survived two sessions: at `deg W = g` the rank anchor
195	`h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one` (`RiemannRoch/FLVClass.lean:412`) gives, for a
196	witness with `h¹ = 0`,
197	`h⁰ = deg W + χ(𝒪) = g + (1 − g) = 1` — exactly the `h⁰ = 1` normalization that DAT-C §2 and
198	GAP-2's uniqueness both require.  So `+g` is not merely the sign that makes the locus nonempty;
199	it is the unique degree at which the witness is *unique*, which is what the chart map needs to be

12	/-!
13	# Native presentations for split field classes
14	
15	A residue-field H¹ witness for the lambda-tied cocycle datum supplies its arbitrary-ring
16	cohomology and rank certificates.  The native all-cartesian base-change theorem then completes
17	the corresponding `PicRankOneNativePresentation` without a separate pushforward hypothesis.
18	
19	A split genus-degree class over a field stays split after every affine coefficient extension,
20	so it supplies those witnesses for each pullback datum.
21	
22	The final theorem is the direct public consumer: a split field class belongs to
23	`PicRankOneOpen`, because every affine pullback receives the presentation constructed here.
24	-/
25	
26	set_option autoImplicit false
27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
28	
29	universe u
30	
31	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
32	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
33	
34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
35	
36	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
37	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
38	
39	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
40	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
41	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
42	
43	noncomputable section
44	
45	/-- Every morphism between affine tests over `Spec k` is induced by a `k`-algebra map.
46	
47	Unlike `exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom`, neither coefficient ring is required to be a
48	field.  This is the form needed when the target of a field-valued Picard point is tested by an
49	arbitrary affine scheme. -/
50	theorem exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing
51	    (R S : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra k R] [Algebra k S]
52	    (t : overSpec k S ⟶ overSpec k R) :
53	    ∃ e : R →ₐ[k] S, t = Over.overSpecMap e := by
54	  have hw : t.left ≫ (overSpec k R).hom = (overSpec k S).hom := Over.w t
55	  let psi : CommRingCat.of R ⟶ CommRingCat.of S := Spec.preimage t.left
56	  have hmap : Spec.map psi = t.left := Spec.map_preimage t.left
57	  have htower : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R) ≫ psi =
58	      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k S) := by
59	    apply Spec.map_injective
60	    rw [Spec.map_comp, hmap]
61	    exact hw
62	  let e : R →ₐ[k] S :=
63	    { __ := psi.hom
64	      commutes' := fun r ↦
65	        congrArg (fun f => f r) (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom htower) }
66	  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
67	  ext : 1
68	  exact hmap.symm
69	
70	/-- Complete the native presentation attached to an actual lambda-tied datum.
71	
72	The input is exactly the remaining family-level H¹ obligation.  The degree law follows from the
73	two class equalities stored in `P`; finiteness, projectivity, and rank one follow from the
74	arbitrary-ring certificate theorem; and native pushforward base change is the canonical
75	all-cartesian theorem.  Thus every field concerns the same cocycle datum. -/
76	noncomputable def PicRankOneNativeDatum.toNativePresentation_of_residueH1Witness
77	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
78	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
79	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
80	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
81	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
82	    (hres : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier,
83	      P.datum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
84	    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam :=
85	  PicRankOneNativePresentation.ofCertificatesWithNativeBaseChange
86	    P.cover P.representative P.represents P.datum P.datum_class
87	      (RankOneFamilyCertificates.ofActualDatum P.datum hpi hres
88	        (fun L ↦ P.classDeg_baseChange L))
89	
90	/-- The arbitrary-affine pullback of a split field class has a complete native presentation.
91	
92	The datum is the representative extracted from the displayed pullback `lam`.  Its residue-field
93	H¹ witnesses come from `hsplit`, while its degree law comes from the equality with `lam`.
94	Consequently all four cohomology/rank fields and the native base-change field concern the same
95	cocycle datum. -/
96	theorem PicRankOneNativePresentation.nonempty_of_fieldPullback
97	    {K A : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
98	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
99	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
100	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
101	    (e : K →ₐ[k] A) (nu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
102	    (hlam : lam.1 = picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap e) nu)
103	    (hsplit : IsSplitWitness C nu) :
104	    Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) := by
105	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := PicRankOneNativeDatum.nonempty (C := C) pi lam
106	  exact ⟨P.toNativePresentation_of_residueH1Witness hpi
107	    (P.residueH1Witness_of_fieldPullback e nu hlam hsplit)⟩
108	
109	/-- A split genus-degree class over a field belongs to the public rank-one Picard locus.
110	
111	Every affine test morphism into `Spec K` is induced by a `k`-algebra map `K → A`; the
112	preceding producer therefore supplies the exact native presentation required on that pullback.
113	-/
114	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness
115	    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
116	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
117	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
118	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K))
119	    (hsplit : IsSplitWitness C lam.1) :
120	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k K)) := by
121	  apply mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
122	  intro A _ _ t
123	  obtain ⟨e, ht⟩ := exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing (k := k) K A t
124	  rw [ht]
125	  exact PicRankOneNativePresentation.nonempty_of_fieldPullback
126	    (C := C) hpi e lam.1 rfl hsplit
127	
128	end
129	
130	end AlgebraicGeometry

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOnePresentation
7	import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Subfunctor.Image
8	
9	/-!
10	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
11	
12	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
13	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
14	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
15	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
16	
17	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
18	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
19	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
20	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
21	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
22	-/
23	
24	set_option autoImplicit false
25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
26	
27	universe u
28	
29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
30	
31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
32	
33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
36	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
37	
38	noncomputable section
39	
40	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
41	
42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
45	def PicRankOneOpen :
46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
48	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
49	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
50	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
51	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
54	      apply Subtype.ext
55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
56	    rw [e]
57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
58	
59	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
60	
61	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
62	
63	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
64	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
65	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
66	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
67	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
68	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
69	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
70	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
71	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
72	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))
73	
74	/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
75	Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
76	field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
77	contract. -/
78	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
79	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
80	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
81	      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
82	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
83	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
84	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
85	  rfl
86	
87	/-- Constructor for the exact lambda-tied arbitrary-affine-pullback presentation contract. -/
88	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations
89	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
90	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
91	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
92	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
93	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
94	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
95	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
96	  (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mpr h
97	
98	/-- Constructor using the named arbitrary-affine producer predicate. -/
99	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentationCondition
100	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
101	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
102	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition pi lam) :
103	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
104	  exact mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi h
105	
106	/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
107	def picRankOneOpenIncl :
108	    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
109	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
110	
111	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
112	
113	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
114	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
115	relative-open gate below. -/
116	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
117	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
118	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
119	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
120	
121	/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.
122	
123	This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
124	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
125	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
126	def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
127	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)
128	
129	/-! ## The explicit fibre producer contract -/
130	
131	/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.
132	
133	The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
134	It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
135	supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
136	or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
137	structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
138	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
139	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
140	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
141	  W : X.Opens
142	  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
143	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
144	  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
145	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
146	    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
147	    (w : S ⟶ X),
148	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
149	      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
150	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
151	      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w
152	
153	namespace PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
154	
155	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
156	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
157	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))}
158	
159	/-- The fibre square supplied by `FibrePresented` is a pullback of presheaves. -/
160	theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
161	    IsPullback D.fst (yoneda.map D.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g := by
162	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
163	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
164	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
165	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
166	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
167	      φ.app S) D.sq
168	  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
169	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
170	  · intro v w hvw
171	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
172	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩
173	
174	end PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
175	
176	/-- An arbitrary-test fibre producer discharges the relative openness gate. -/
177	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented
178	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
179	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
180	        Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))),
181	      PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
182	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
183	  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists ?_
184	  intro X g
185	  let d := D X g
186	  exact ⟨d.W, d.fst, d.W.ι, d.isPullback, inferInstance⟩
187	
188	/-- Expose a supplied relative-open certificate without hiding it behind typeclass search. -/
189	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate
190	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi :=
191	  h
192	
193	/-- Extract the open immersion supplied by the relative-openness certificate on an arbitrary
194	pullback.  This is the exact shape consumed by an eventual chart/fibre producer. -/
195	theorem picRankOneOpen_openPullback
196	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
197	    {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
198	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
199	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))
200	    (fst : yoneda.obj Z ⟶
201	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor)

8	/-!
9	# Finite separable field extensions are étale covers, and the descent test they give
10	
11	This file supplies the **cover** that the repaired campaign tail `G1`/`G3` needs:
12	`Spec k' ⟶ Spec k` for a finite separable extension `k'/k` is a *singleton étale
13	covering* of `Spec k`, its base change along any `k`-scheme `T` is again one, and
14	the resulting sieve lies in `etaleTopologyOver k` — the site on which
15	`PicScheme.picEt` is a sheaf.
16	
17	## Why this file exists
18	
19	The seam's single open obligation `Scheme.fgaPicardRepresentability`
20	(`Picard/FGAPicRepresentability.lean`) is routed through the Milne–Kollár
21	campaign (`informal/pic-representability-campaign.md`). That campaign builds a
22	representing scheme over a separably closed field (`J1`–`J5`), spreads it to a
23	finite Galois level (`G1`) and descends to `k` (`G3`). Its tail is stated for
24	`picSharp`, and that is where the route is believed to break:
25	`PicScheme.not_exists_representing_picSharp_of_not_isIso`
26	(`Picard/PicEtSubcanonical.lean`) proves that **no** scheme represents
27	`picSharp C` once `picEtComparison C` fails to be an isomorphism.
28	
29	**That is a conditional theorem, and the antecedent is not formalised** — stated
30	plainly because this file's own earlier revision asserted the conclusion flatly.
31	`¬IsIso (picEtComparison C)` is an explicit hypothesis of that theorem, proved for
32	no curve. Kleiman's real conic `u²+v²+w²=0` in `ℙ²_ℝ` meets the *binders*
33	(smooth, proper, geometrically integral, no rational point) and he states the
34	non-representability, but the Lean antecedent — that the comparison genuinely
35	fails there, via `φ*O(1)` and `h⁰` on `ℙ¹_ℂ` — is quoted rather than proved
36	(`PicEtSubcanonical.lean` §4 says so of itself). So the honest form is: *if* the
37	comparison fails for one such curve, `G3`/`G4` target a false statement; and the
38	repair is then to descend `picEt`, which **is** an étale sheaf
39	(`PicScheme.picEt_isSheaf_forget`) — whereas whether `picSharp` fails étale
40	descent is likewise not proved here (`th:cmp` part 1 shows it is at least
41	Zariski-*separated* on these binders).
42	
43	Under that repair the descent step needs `Spec k' ⟶ Spec k` to be an **étale
44	covering** in Mathlib's sense, and nothing in the tree provided that. §1–§3 prove
45	it. §4 records what the sheaf side contributes, which is less than an earlier
46	revision claimed. It is infrastructure, not a discharge:
47	
48	**No `sorry` is closed here, and no antecedent of the seam is witnessed.** What
49	changes is that the cover the restated `G3` quantifies over is now a theorem
50	rather than a hypothesis.
51	
52	## The measurement that motivated the shape of the proofs
53	
54	`Algebra.Etale k k'` does **not** synthesize from
55	`[Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] [Module.Finite k k']`, and neither does
56	`Etale (Spec.map …)`; a lane reading a failing `infer_instance` as an absence
57	would conclude this cover is unavailable. Both are assembled below from theorem
58	forms (`Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable`,
59	`Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType`, `RingHom.etale_algebraMap`,
60	`HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff`). The *base change* of the cover, by contrast, is
61	free by synthesis — `Etale` and `Surjective` are both stable under base change in
62	Mathlib.
63	
64	The sibling project `Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild` has a
65	character-identical `Algebra.Etale` instance — the *anonymous*
66	`instance : Algebra.Etale K L` at `AlgebraicJacobian/Algebra/EtaleCover.lean:304`,
67	not the `def` `Algebra.EtaleCover.ofField` below it. The duplication is
68	unavoidable rather than an oversight: AJC's `lakefile.toml` requires only
69	`checkdecls`, `doc-gen4` and `mathlib`, no AJCR file is in AJC's import closure,
70	and there is no dependency edge to add one. The scheme-level covering statements
71	below are in neither project.
72	
73	Both hypotheses are load-bearing, measured by dropping each: without
74	`[Algebra.IsSeparable k k']`, and separately without `[Module.Finite k k']`,
75	`etale_specMap_algebraMap` fails with
76	`failed to synthesize instance of type class Algebra.Etale …`.
77	
78	## Main results
79	
80	* `Scheme.etale_specMap_algebraMap` — `Spec k' ⟶ Spec k` is étale.
81	* `Scheme.surjective_specMap_algebraMap` — and surjective (both spectra are
82	  one-point), so no separability or finiteness is used.
83	* `Scheme.singleton_mem_etalePrecoverage_specMap` — the singleton family is an
84	  étale cover of `Spec k`.
85	* `Scheme.etale_pullback_fst_specMap` / `Scheme.surjective_pullback_fst_specMap`
86	  — its base change along an arbitrary `k`-scheme is again étale and surjective.
87	* `Scheme.sieve_specMap_mem_etaleTopology` — the generated sieve is a covering
88	  sieve of `Scheme.etaleTopology`.
89	* `Scheme.isSheafFor_picEt_of_mem` — the sheaf axiom of `picEt C` at an
90	  **arbitrary** covering sieve, `PicScheme.picEt_isSheaf_forget` unfolded. Free
91	  from sheafification; recorded to make clear that §4 is not where the work is.
92	* `Scheme.isSheafFor_picEt_pullback_presieve` — the same at the field-extension
93	  cover. Its content over the previous item is the membership witness, i.e. §1–§3.
94	* `Scheme.picEt_ext_of_pullback_agrees` — the uniqueness half alone: restriction
95	  along the cover is injective on `picEt`-classes.
96	
97	Nothing in the tree consumes these yet; the consumer is the restated `G3`.
98

102	Campaign milestones `G1`, `G3`. Board: `AJC.picrep.etale-rep`. Decision:
103	`I-0491`.

114	/-! ## §1. The étale algebra structure -/
115	
116	section Algebra
117	
118	variable (k k' : Type u) [Field k] [Field k'] [Algebra k k']
119	  [Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] [Module.Finite k k']
120	
121	/-- **A finite separable field extension is an étale algebra.**
122	
123	Formal étaleness is separability (`Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable`), and
124	finite presentation follows from finite type over a field
125	(`Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType`, the Noetherian criterion).
126	
127	Stated as an `instance` because both inputs are, and because
128	`Algebra.Etale k k'` does *not* synthesize without it: this is the declaration
129	whose absence makes the étale cover below look unavailable. -/
130	instance etale_of_finite_isSeparable : Algebra.Etale k k' where
131	  formallyEtale := Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable k k'
132	  finitePresentation :=
133	    (Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType (R := k) (A := k')).mp inferInstance
134	
135	end Algebra

137	/-! ## §2. The scheme-level cover -/
138	
139	section Cover
140	
141	variable (k k' : Type u) [Field k] [Field k'] [Algebra k k']
142	
143	/-- **`Spec k' ⟶ Spec k` is surjective on points**, for *any* extension of
144	fields: both spectra have exactly one point, so this needs neither separability
145	nor finiteness.
146	
147	Stated on the underlying map because that is the form
148	`Scheme.singleton_mem_precoverage_iff` consumes; the morphism-property version is
149	`surjective_specMap_algebraMap` below. -/
150	theorem surjective_base_specMap_algebraMap :
151	    Function.Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))).base :=
152	  fun _ => ⟨default, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
153	
154	/-- `Spec k' ⟶ Spec k` is surjective as a morphism property. -/
155	theorem surjective_specMap_algebraMap :
156	    Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) :=
157	  ⟨surjective_base_specMap_algebraMap k k'⟩
158	
159	variable [Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] [Module.Finite k k']
160	
161	/-- **`Spec k' ⟶ Spec k` is étale** for `k'/k` finite separable.
162	
163	The bridge from the algebra statement of §1 to the morphism property is
164	`RingHom.etale_algebraMap` followed by `HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff`. It is
165	needed because `Etale (Spec.map …)` does not synthesize: `RingHom.Etale f` is
166	`Algebra.Etale` at `f.toAlgebra`, which is not the ambient `Algebra k k'`
167	instance up to reducible defeq. -/
168	theorem etale_specMap_algebraMap :
169	    Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) :=
170	  (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)).mpr
171	    (RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance)
172	
173	/-- **The singleton family `{Spec k' ⟶ Spec k}` is an étale cover of `Spec k`.**
174	
175	`Scheme.singleton_mem_precoverage_iff` reduces membership in the étale
176	precoverage to exactly the two facts above: surjectivity on points, and the
177	morphism property. -/
178	theorem singleton_mem_etalePrecoverage_specMap :
179	    Presieve.singleton (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) ∈
180	      Scheme.precoverage @Etale (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := by
181	  rw [Scheme.singleton_mem_precoverage_iff]
182	  exact ⟨surjective_base_specMap_algebraMap k k', etale_specMap_algebraMap k k'⟩
183	
184	/-- The sieve generated by the field-extension cover is a **covering sieve** of
185	the big étale topology on schemes. This is the form the sheaf axiom of
186	`PicSharp.etaleSheaf` is stated against. -/
187	theorem sieve_specMap_mem_etaleTopology :
188	    Sieve.generate
189	        (Presieve.singleton (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))) ∈
190	      Scheme.etaleTopology (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
191	  Precoverage.generate_mem_toGrothendieck (singleton_mem_etalePrecoverage_specMap k k')
192	
193	end Cover

200	  [Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] [Module.Finite k k']
201	
202	/-- **The base-changed cover is étale.** `Etale` is stable under base change in
203	Mathlib (`AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.etale_isStableUnderBaseChange`), so this needs
204	no argument beyond §2 — recorded because it is the form `G1`'s spreading step
205	consumes, at an arbitrary test object rather than at `Spec k`. -/
206	theorem etale_pullback_fst_specMap (T : Scheme.{u}) (a : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
207	    Etale (pullback.fst a (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))) :=
208	  haveI := etale_specMap_algebraMap k k'
209	  inferInstance
210	
211	omit [Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] [Module.Finite k k'] in
212	/-- **The base-changed cover is surjective**, so it is again a cover. Together
213	with `etale_pullback_fst_specMap` this says the field-extension cover pulls back
214	to an étale cover of every `k`-scheme.
215	
216	Needs neither separability nor finiteness, for the same reason
217	`surjective_base_specMap_algebraMap` does not. -/
218	theorem surjective_pullback_fst_specMap (T : Scheme.{u})
219	    (a : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
220	    Surjective (pullback.fst a (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))) :=
221	  haveI := surjective_specMap_algebraMap k k'
222	  inferInstance

226	/-! ## §4. The descent test for `picEt` -/
227	
228	section Descent
229	
230	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (k' : Type u) [Field k'] [Algebra k k']
231	  [Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] [Module.Finite k k']
232	
233	/-- The base-changed cover, as an étale cover of the *underlying scheme* of a
234	slice object `T`. Restatement of §3 in presieve form. -/
235	theorem singleton_pullback_mem_etalePrecoverage (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
236	    Presieve.singleton
237	        (pullback.fst T.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))) ∈
238	      Scheme.precoverage @Etale T.left := by
239	  haveI := etale_specMap_algebraMap k k'
240	  haveI : Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) :=
241	    surjective_specMap_algebraMap k k'
242	  rw [Scheme.singleton_mem_precoverage_iff]
243	  exact ⟨Surjective.surj
244	    (f := pullback.fst T.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))),
245	    inferInstance⟩
246	
247	/-- **The field-extension cover, transported into the site `(Sch/k)`** on which
248	the relative Picard presheaf lives.
249	
250	`etaleTopologyOver k` is `Scheme.etaleTopology.over (Spec k)`, whose covering
251	sieves are by definition those whose image under `Sieve.overEquiv` covers the
252	underlying scheme; `GrothendieckTopology.overEquiv_symm_mem_over` is that
253	definition read backwards. -/
254	theorem sieve_pullback_mem_etaleTopologyOver (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
255	    (Sieve.overEquiv T).symm
256	        (Sieve.generate (Presieve.singleton
257	          (pullback.fst T.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))))) ∈
258	      etaleTopologyOver k T :=
259	  GrothendieckTopology.overEquiv_symm_mem_over (J := Scheme.etaleTopology) T _
260	    (Precoverage.generate_mem_toGrothendieck
261	      (singleton_pullback_mem_etalePrecoverage k' T))
262	
263	/-- **The sheaf axiom of `picEt` at an arbitrary covering sieve.**
264	
265	This is `PicScheme.picEt_isSheaf_forget` (`Picard/PicEtSheaf.lean`) unfolded at
266	one sieve, and it is stated here to make the division of labour explicit: the
267	sheaf property is **free** — it is `PicSharp.etaleSheaf`'s own `Sheaf.cond`,
268	pushed through the forgetful functor — and holds at *every* covering sieve of
269	`etaleTopologyOver k`, the trivial sieve `⊤` included. Nothing about a field
270	extension enters.
271	
272	An earlier revision of this file proved the sheaf property again here, by a

277	campaign's descent step needs and that the tree did not have. -/
278	theorem isSheafFor_picEt_of_mem (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
279	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
280	    {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (S : Sieve T)

282	    Presieve.IsSheafFor (PicScheme.picEt C) (S : Presieve T) :=

285	/-- **The sheaf axiom of `picEt` at the field-extension cover.**
286	
287	Concretely: for a `k`-scheme `T` and a finite separable `k'/k`, a family of
288	`Pic_{(C/k)ét}`-classes on `T ×_k k'` that is compatible on overlaps has a
289	*unique* amalgamation on `T`. No hypothesis on `C(k)` anywhere.

291	**Where the content is, stated precisely because an earlier revision of this
292	docstring got it wrong.** That revision called this "THE DESCENT TEST" and "the
293	payoff", implying the sheaf side was the achievement. It is not: by
294	`isSheafFor_picEt_of_mem` the amalgamation property holds at *every* covering
295	sieve, `⊤` included, for free from sheafification. The only thing this
296	declaration adds over that is the *membership witness* — that this particular
297	family, the one the campaign's descent step actually restricts along, is a
298	covering sieve. That witness is §1–§3, and it is what the tree lacked.
299

301	descended object. Turning a `k'`-representing scheme into a `k`-representing one

310	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
311	    Presieve.IsSheafFor (PicScheme.picEt C)
312	      (((Sieve.overEquiv T).symm
313	        (Sieve.generate (Presieve.singleton
314	          (pullback.fst T.hom
315	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))))))) : Presieve T) :=

341	      (PicScheme.picEt C).map g.op t₁ = (PicScheme.picEt C).map g.op t₂) :
342	    t₁ = t₂ :=

9	/-!
10	# The relative Picard functor on affine test algebras
11	
12	The étale sheafification of the relative Picard functor is computed over *affine* test
13	objects, where a test object is `Spec` of a `k`-algebra `A` (the landed
14	`AlgebraicGeometry.overSpec k A : Over (Spec k)`) and a test map is `Spec` of a `k`-algebra
15	map.  This file provides the algebra-indexed face of the relative Picard functor:
16	
17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.overSpecMap f`: `Spec` of a `k`-algebra map `f : A →ₐ[k] B`, as a
18	  morphism `overSpec k B ⟶ overSpec k A` of `Over (Spec k)`, strictly functorial
19	  (`overSpecMap_id`, `overSpecMap_comp`).
20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPicAlgMap C f`: restriction of relative Picard classes along
21	  `Spec f`, a group homomorphism `relPic C (overSpec k A) →* relPic C (overSpec k B)`,
22	  covariantly functorial in the algebra (`relPicAlgMap_id`, `relPicAlgMap_comp`).
23	
24	The étale plus construction (`Picard/PicEtAff.lean`) consumes only this interface: descent
25	classes on an étale cover are an equalizer of two `relPicAlgMap`s, and all refinement
26	transports are `relPicAlgMap`s of `A`-algebra maps restricted to `k`.
27	-/

34	
35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry

37	section OverSpecMap
38	
39	variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
40	variable {A B C' D : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
41	  [CommRing C'] [Algebra k C'] [CommRing D] [Algebra k D]

43	/-- `Spec` of a `k`-algebra map, as a morphism of `Over (Spec k)`. -/
44	noncomputable def Over.overSpecMap (f : A →ₐ[k] B) : overSpec k B ⟶ overSpec k A :=
45	  Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom)) (by
46	    dsimp
47	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, AlgHom.comp_algebraMap])
48	
49	@[simp]
50	lemma Over.overSpecMap_left (f : A →ₐ[k] B) :
51	    (Over.overSpecMap f).left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom) :=
52	  rfl
53	
54	private lemma spec_map_id_alg :
55	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AlgHom.id k A).toRingHom) = 𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) := by
56	  rw [show CommRingCat.ofHom (AlgHom.id k A).toRingHom = 𝟙 (CommRingCat.of A) from rfl,
57	    Spec.map_id]
58	
59	private lemma spec_map_comp_alg (f : A →ₐ[k] B) (g : B →ₐ[k] C') :
60	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (g.comp f).toRingHom)
61	      = (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g.toRingHom) :
62	            Spec (CommRingCat.of C') ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of B))
63	          ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom) := by
64	  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
65	  rfl
66	
67	@[simp]
68	lemma Over.overSpecMap_id : Over.overSpecMap (AlgHom.id k A) = 𝟙 (overSpec k A) := by
69	  ext : 1
70	  exact spec_map_id_alg
71	
72	@[simp]
73	lemma Over.overSpecMap_comp (f : A →ₐ[k] B) (g : B →ₐ[k] C') :
74	    Over.overSpecMap (g.comp f) = Over.overSpecMap g ≫ Over.overSpecMap f := by
75	  ext : 1
76	  exact spec_map_comp_alg f g
77	
78	end OverSpecMap

82	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
83	variable {A B C' : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
84	  [CommRing C'] [Algebra k C']

86	/-- Restriction of relative Picard classes along `Spec` of a `k`-algebra map: the
87	algebra-indexed face of the relative Picard functor, covariant in the algebra. -/
88	noncomputable def relPicAlgMap (f : A →ₐ[k] B) :
89	    relPic C (overSpec k A) →* relPic C (overSpec k B) :=
90	  relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap f)
91	
92	@[simp]
93	lemma relPicAlgMap_id (x : relPic C (overSpec k A)) :
94	    relPicAlgMap C (AlgHom.id k A) x = x := by
95	  rw [relPicAlgMap, Over.overSpecMap_id]
96	  exact relPicMap_id C x
97	
98	lemma relPicAlgMap_comp (f : A →ₐ[k] B) (g : B →ₐ[k] C') (x : relPic C (overSpec k A)) :
99	    relPicAlgMap C (g.comp f) x = relPicAlgMap C g (relPicAlgMap C f x) := by
100	  rw [relPicAlgMap, Over.overSpecMap_comp]

109	
110	/-- **The chart-membership witness predicate at a field `L`** — the field-parametrised
111	form of the set of `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing`
112	(`Pic0ChartLocusOpen`): the fibre class of `D` at `L` admits an effective witness divisor
113	with vanishing `H¹`.  For `L = q.asIdeal.ResidueField` this is definitionally membership
114	of `q` in the keystone-1 witness locus. -/
115	def BasicOpenCocycleDatum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
116	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra B L] [IsScalarTower k B L] : Prop :=
117	  ∃ W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor,
118	    Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W
119	        = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B L) D.cechPicClass
120	      ∧ Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1)
121	
122	/-- The witness predicate is the engine's complex-form fibre condition
123	`Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] L)`, via the two-way datum dictionary
124	`subsingleton_h1_tensor_iff_exists_witness` (C1, GAP-6). -/
125	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton
126	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra B L]
127	    [IsScalarTower k B L] :
128	    D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L ↔ Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] L) :=
129	  (D.subsingleton_h1_tensor_iff_exists_witness L).symm
130	
131	/-! ## The fibre-field invariance (the gap-2 core) -/
132	
133	/-- **CHART-U(b) gap-2 core — fibre-field invariance of witness h¹-vanishing**: for a
134	pinned datum `D` over the affine base `B` and a field extension `L → L'` inside the
135	`k`/`B` tower (the residue-field seam `κ(p) → κ(q)` of a carrier map `comap f`), the
136	witness h¹-vanishing of `D` at `L` transfers to and from `L'`.
137	
138	Both sides are, via the datum dictionary, `Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] ·)`, and
139	that transfers along the (faithfully flat) field extension `L → L'`
140	(`subsingleton_tensorProduct_field_ext_iff`).  In particular this covers the separable
141	residue-field extensions of an étale/étale-plus carrier map. -/
142	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension
143	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
144	    (L L' : Type u) [Field L] [Field L'] [Algebra k L] [Algebra k L']
145	    [Algebra B L] [Algebra B L'] [IsScalarTower k B L] [IsScalarTower k B L']
146	    [Algebra L L'] [IsScalarTower B L L'] :
147	    D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L ↔ D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L' := by
148	  rw [D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton L,
149	      D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton L']
150	  exact subsingleton_tensorProduct_field_ext_iff
151	
152	/-- **The separable specialisation the CHART-U(b) transport (ii) names** (I-0252 gap 2):
153	for a **separable** residue-field extension `L → L'` (`Algebra.IsSeparable`, the case of
154	an étale/étale-plus carrier map), witness h¹-vanishing of `D` transfers between `L` and
155	`L'`.  Separability is recorded to name the intended consumer; the transfer holds for any
156	field extension (`hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension`). -/
157	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_separable
158	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
159	    (L L' : Type u) [Field L] [Field L'] [Algebra k L] [Algebra k L']
160	    [Algebra B L] [Algebra B L'] [IsScalarTower k B L] [IsScalarTower k B L']
161	    [Algebra L L'] [IsScalarTower B L L'] [Algebra.IsSeparable L L'] :
162	    D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L ↔ D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L' :=
163	  D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension L L'
164	
165	/-! ## Fixed-field class-intrinsicity (the other half the `comap` identity needs) -/
166	
167	/-- **Class-intrinsicity of the witness predicate at a fixed field** (V1a): the witness
168	h¹-vanishing predicate depends only on the mapped fibre class
169	`Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B L) D.cechPicClass`, so two data — over possibly
170	different bases `B`, `B'` — whose fibre classes at `L` agree have the same witness
171	predicate at `L`.
172	
173	Together with `hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension` (the `κ(p) → κ(q)` transfer)
174	this is exactly what the CHART-U(b) `comap`-preimage identity reduces to at C9-time; the
175	one residual input is the shifted-datum class identity of I-0252 gap 1 (the Σ/θ
176	naturality), which is divRep-gated. -/
177	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_congr_of_cechPicClass_eq
178	    {B' : Type u} [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B']
179	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) (D' : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B' π)
180	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra B L] [Algebra B' L]
181	    [IsScalarTower k B L] [IsScalarTower k B' L]
182	    (hcl : Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B L) D.cechPicClass
183	        = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B' L) D'.cechPicClass) :
184	    D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L ↔ D'.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L := by
185	  simp only [BasicOpenCocycleDatum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing, hcl]

18	
19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
23

80	/-- **The bridge between the Over-category product and Scheme-level pullbacks.** For two
81	objects `X, T` of `Over S`, the underlying scheme of the cartesian-monoidal product
82	`(X ⊗ T).left` together with the two projections is the fibre product of `X.hom` and
83	`T.hom`. This is the single point where `C ⊗ Spec A` is unfolded to `Limits.pullback`;
84	everything downstream consumes this `IsPullback` datum. -/
85	theorem Over.isPullback_left (X T : Over S) :
86	    IsPullback (fst X T).left (snd X T).left X.hom T.hom := by
87	  simp only [Over.fst_left, Over.snd_left]
88	  exact IsPullback.of_hasPullback X.hom T.hom
89	
90	end Bridge
91	
92	section OverSpec
93	
94	variable (k : Type u) [CommRing k] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
95	
96	/-- `Spec A` as an object of `Over (Spec k)`, for a commutative `k`-algebra `A`. -/
97	noncomputable abbrev overSpec : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
98	  Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))
99	
100	@[simp]
101	lemma overSpec_left : (overSpec k A).left = Spec (.of A) := rfl
102	
103	@[simp]
104	lemma overSpec_hom :
105	    (overSpec k A).hom = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) := rfl
106	
107	/-- The underlying scheme of `overSpec k A` is affine (it is `Spec A`); form usable where
108	`IsAffineOpen (⊤ : (overSpec k A).left.Opens)` is expected. -/
109	lemma isAffineOpen_top_overSpec : IsAffineOpen (⊤ : (overSpec k A).left.Opens) :=
110	  isAffineOpen_top (Spec (.of A))
111	
112	/-- Over a field, `Spec A ⟶ Spec k` is flat, for every commutative `k`-algebra `A`. -/
113	instance flat_overSpec_hom {k : Type u} [Field k] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] :
114	    Flat (overSpec k A).hom :=
115	  Flat.SpecMap_iff.mpr (by
116	    rw [CommRingCat.hom_ofHom]
117	    exact RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.mpr inferInstance)
118	
119	end OverSpec

10	# The shared plus-class field collapse (DAT-B B-5 fibre collapse / B-4 gap-1 collapse)
11	
12	This is the **shared plus-class collapse lemma** flagged by `w4-datb-worksheet.md` §5
13	risk 6 and by the B-4 landing note I-0252 ("state it once as a named lemma with a
14	characterizing property … both consume it"): a plus class of the one-step étale-plus
15	Picard group over a *field* becomes an honest relative-Picard class after base change to a
16	suitable finite separable field extension.
17	
18	Over a field `K`, a plus class `p : PicEtAff C K` is `PicEtAff.mk E x` for a presented
19	étale cover `E` of `Spec K` and a descent class `x` (`Picard/PicEtAff.lean`).  Field
20	cofinality (`Algebra.EtaleCover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom`,
21	`Algebra/EtaleCover.lean` — étale covers of a field are refined by finite separable field
22	extensions) supplies a finite separable `L/K` together with a `K`-algebra map
23	`ℓ : E.Carrier →ₐ[K] L`.  Base-changing `E` to `L` yields a cover with an `L`-point, so the
24	base-changed descent class is, by the descent/cocycle condition (`relPicAlgMap_congr`), the
25	tautological datum of an honest class: `PicEtAff.map C L p` is the plus-unit of the
26	relative-Picard class `relPicAlgMap ℓ x` on `C_L` (`PicEtAff.unit C L …`).
27	
28	## Main results
29	
30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_of_algHom` — the collapse: `mk C E x`
31	  restricted over a finite separable `L/K` (via a `K`-algebra map `ℓ` of the cover
32	  carrier) is `PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicAlgMap ℓ x)`.
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_relPicMk_of_algHom` — the same with the honest
34	  class presented as `relPicMk` of a Čech Picard class `M` on `C_L`, the form the degree
35	  seam (`degAt_of_affineEquiv_eq_unit_relPicMk`) and the shifted-datum extraction
36	  (`exists_cechPicClass_eq`) consume.
37	
38	The finite separable `L` with `ℓ : E.Carrier →ₐ[K] L` is supplied by field cofinality
39	(`Algebra.EtaleCover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom`).  Both statements take the tower
40	`k → K → L` as clean instance hypotheses — the campaign-idiomatic fibre-extension form
41	(cf. `Picard/DivSchemeSeed.lean`).  A consumer must instantiate `L` with a well-behaved
42	`Algebra k L` (a native tower); a `RingHom.toAlgebra`-composite `letI` triggers the
43	two-level-tower diamond of I-0236 when `PicEtAff.map C L` unfolds the base-changed carrier
44	(a genuine `whnf` non-termination, verified this pass — see the landing note).
45	
46	The statements carry **no** hypotheses on the curve `C.hom` (they are purely about the
47	plus construction), so they are available to every consumer of the plus group.
48	-/

9	# CHART-U(b) gap-2, the chartLocus-free core — fibre-field invariance of witness
10	h¹-vanishing (`informal/w4-datb-worksheet.md` §1.6 transport (ii), I-0252 gap 2)
11	
12	CHART-U(b)'s transport (ii) (the "one `IsOpenMap` application", `Pic0ChartLocusOpen`
13	keystones 2/3) pushes the engine's open witness locus from the étale carrier `Spec B`
14	down to the test base `Spec A`.  Its remaining mathematical content (I-0252 gap 2) is
15	the *fibre-field invariance* that identifies the preimage of the base locus with the
16	carrier locus: for a prime `q` of the carrier over `p`, the residue-field extension
17	`κ(q)/κ(p)` is separable (étale/étale-plus carrier) and must **preserve** the witness
18	h¹-vanishing of the fibre class.
19	
20	That content is `chartLocus`-free (I-0252's phrasing through the still-undefined
21	`chartLocus`, DAT-C C9, is pure plumbing on top) and is landed here in the **witness
22	form** `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing`
23	(`Pic0ChartLocusOpen`) uses.  The heart is a single module fact:
24	
25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.subsingleton_tensorProduct_field_ext_iff` — for an `S`-module `H`
26	  and a field extension `L → L'` in the `S`-tower, `H ⊗[S] L` is subsingleton iff
27	  `H ⊗[S] L'` is.  Going up is `0 ⊗ = 0`; coming down is the faithful flatness of the
28	  (nonzero) field extension.  **Separability is not needed** — every field extension is
29	  faithfully flat; it is the geometric packaging (étale carrier) that makes the residue
30	  extensions separable, not the transfer.
31	
32	Read through the two-way datum dictionary
33	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.subsingleton_h1_tensor_iff_exists_witness` (C1, GAP-6) — under
34	which the witness predicate at a field `L` is exactly the engine's complex-form fibre
35	condition `Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] L)` — this gives:
36	
37	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing` — the field-parametrised witness
38	  predicate; for `L = κ(q)` it is membership of `q` in the keystone-1 locus.
39	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension` — **the gap-2
40	  core**: witness h¹-vanishing of `D` at `L` transfers to and from `L'` for any field
41	  extension `L → L'` in the `k`/`B` tower.
42	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_separable` — the separable
43	  specialisation the CHART-U(b) consumer names (`Algebra.IsSeparable`).
44	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_congr_of_cechPicClass_eq` — the fixed-
45	  field class-intrinsicity (V1a): the witness predicate depends only on the mapped fibre
46	  class, so two data with equal fibre class at `L` have the same predicate.
47	
48	## What the CHART-U(b) / C9 assembly consumes and the residual (I-0252 gap 2)
49	
50	The `comap`-preimage identity keystone 3 needs, `comap f ⁻¹'(chartLocus_A) = locus_B`,
51	reduces pointwise (for `q` over `p`, `κ(q)/κ(p)` separable) to two links:
52	`hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension` (the `κ(p) → κ(q)` field transfer, landed
53	here) composed with `hasWitnessH1Vanishing_congr_of_cechPicClass_eq` at the fixed field
54	`κ(q)` (landed here).  The **residual** is the input to the latter — the shifted-datum
55	class identity `map (relCurveMap … κ(q)) D_A.cechPicClass = map (relCurveMap … κ(q))
56	D_B.cechPicClass` (I-0252 gap 1, the Σ/θ naturality) — and the `chartLocus` definition
57	itself (DAT-C C9).  Both are divRep/C9-gated; neither is a mathematical wall on the
58	invariance itself, which is complete.
59	-/

83	/-- **Base change of a module along a field extension preserves triviality**: for an
84	`S`-module `H` and a field extension `L → L'` inside the `S`-tower, `H ⊗[S] L` is
85	subsingleton iff `H ⊗[S] L'` is.

87	Going up is `0 ⊗ = 0`; coming down is the faithful flatness of the (nonzero) field

89	base-change-in-stages equivalence `(TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange)`.
90	**Separability is not used** — every field extension is faithfully flat. -/
91	theorem subsingleton_tensorProduct_field_ext_iff
92	    {S L L' H : Type u} [CommRing S] [Field L] [Field L'] [Algebra S L] [Algebra S L']
93	    [Algebra L L'] [IsScalarTower S L L'] [AddCommGroup H] [Module S H] :
94	    Subsingleton (H ⊗[S] L) ↔ Subsingleton (H ⊗[S] L') := by
95	  have e := TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange S L L' L' H
96	  rw [(TensorProduct.comm S H L).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr,
97	      (TensorProduct.comm S H L').toEquiv.subsingleton_congr,
98	      ← e.toEquiv.subsingleton_congr]
99	  exact ⟨fun _ => inferInstance,
100	    fun _ => Module.FaithfullyFlat.lTensor_reflects_triviality L L' (L ⊗[S] H)⟩

135	`k`/`B` tower (the residue-field seam `κ(p) → κ(q)` of a carrier map `comap f`), the

139	that transfers along the (faithfully flat) field extension `L → L'`
140	(`subsingleton_tensorProduct_field_ext_iff`).  In particular this covers the separable
141	residue-field extensions of an étale/étale-plus carrier map. -/
142	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension
143	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
144	    (L L' : Type u) [Field L] [Field L'] [Algebra k L] [Algebra k L']
145	    [Algebra B L] [Algebra B L'] [IsScalarTower k B L] [IsScalarTower k B L']
146	    [Algebra L L'] [IsScalarTower B L L'] :
147	    D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L ↔ D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L' := by

156	field extension (`hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension`). -/

158	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
159	    (L L' : Type u) [Field L] [Field L'] [Algebra k L] [Algebra k L']

177	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_congr_of_cechPicClass_eq
178	    {B' : Type u} [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B']
179	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) (D' : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B' π)

11	/-!
12	# Cover independence for section-cut evaluation divisors
13	
14	The evaluation divisor used by the arbitrary-scheme `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`
15	producer is cut from an actual glued section.  Pulling such a divisor through an affine
16	coefficient change retains the pulled-back pointed cover, whereas the direct construction
17	uses the canonical pointed cover of the base-changed cocycle datum.  This file supplies the
18	pure refinement step between those covers: local equations cut by the same section on any
19	two subordinated pointed covers are `DivEq`.
20	
21	The comparison unit is the datum's transition unit restricted to the common refinement.
22	Thus this result records construction-level divisor equality, not merely equality of Picard
23	classes, and assumes neither `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` nor a pullback square.
24	-/
25

27	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

44	/-- Local equations cut by one glued section are independent, up to `DivEq`, of the
45	subordinated pointed cover used to write them.  The witness is the intersection cover and
46	the restricted transition unit between the two selected datum pieces. -/
47	theorem sectionLocalEquations_divEq_of_same_section
48	    [IsAffineHom pi]
49	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
50	    (s : ↑(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
51	    (W W' : (relCurve C B).PointedCover)
52	    (σ σ' : relCurve C B → D.index)
53	    (hσ : ∀ x : relCurve C B, W.opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ x))
54	    (hσ' : ∀ x : relCurve C B, W'.opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ' x))
55	    (hreg : ∀ (j : D.index) (x : relCurve C B) (hx : x ∈ D.pieces j),
56	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) x hx).hom (D.component s j)
57	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk x)) :
58	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
59	      (D.sectionLocalEquations s W σ hσ hreg)
60	      (D.sectionLocalEquations s W' σ' hσ' hreg) := by
61	  refine ⟨W ⊓ W', (fun _ => inf_le_left), (fun _ => inf_le_right), fun x => ?_⟩
62	  have hleft : (W ⊓ W').opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ x) :=
63	    inf_le_left.trans (hσ x)
64	  have hright : (W ⊓ W').opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ' x) :=
65	    inf_le_right.trans (hσ' x)
66	  have hoverlap : (W ⊓ W').opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ x) ⊓ D.pieces (σ' x) :=
67	    le_inf hleft hright
68	  have htriple : (W ⊓ W').opens x ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces (σ x) ⊓ D.pieces (σ' x) :=
69	    le_inf (le_inf le_top hleft) hright
70	  refine ⟨(relCurve C B).unitsRestrict hoverlap (D.unit (σ x) (σ' x)), ?_⟩
71	  have key := congrArg ((relCurve C B).resHom htriple)
72	    (s.property (σ x) (σ' x))
73	  rw [map_mul] at key
74	  simp only [sectionLocalEquations_eqn]
75	  change (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_left
76	      ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ x) (D.component s (σ x))) =
77	    ((relCurve C B).unitsRestrict hoverlap (D.unit (σ x) (σ' x)) :
78	      Γ(relCurve C B, (W ⊓ W').opens x)) *
79	      (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_right
80	        ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ' x) (D.component s (σ' x)))
81	  rw [show (((relCurve C B).unitsRestrict hoverlap (D.unit (σ x) (σ' x)) :
82	      Γ(relCurve C B, (W ⊓ W').opens x)ˣ) : Γ(relCurve C B, (W ⊓ W').opens x)) =
83	        (relCurve C B).resHom hoverlap
84	          (D.unit (σ x) (σ' x) : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces (σ x) ⊓ D.pieces (σ' x)))
85	      from rfl, BasicOpenCocycleDatum.component, BasicOpenCocycleDatum.component]
86	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key ⊢
87	  exact key

91	/-- Restricting the datum-piece comparison to the actual preimage piece gives the
92	arbitrary-affine section comparison.  This is the pointwise equation bridge between the
93	base-changed glued section and `LocalEquations.pullbackEqn`. -/
94	theorem resHom_piecesMap_eq_relAffSectionsMap
95	    [IsAffineHom pi]
96	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
97	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
98	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] (j : D.index)
99	    (t : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j)) :
100	    (relCurve C B').resHom
101	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces_baseChange B' j).ge
102	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap B' j t) =
103	      relAffSectionsMap C B' (D.pieces j) t := by
104	  cases j with
105	  | inl j =>
106	      simpa only [BasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap, pieceSectionsMap,
107	        BasicOpenCoverData.pieces, BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange, Sum.elim_inl,
108	        relAffSectionsMap, Scheme.resHom_refl] using
109	        ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
110	          (le_rfl : D.pieces (Sum.inl j) ≤ D.pieces (Sum.inl j))
111	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' (Sum.inl j))
112	          (le_rfl : relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces (Sum.inl j) ≤
113	            relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces (Sum.inl j))
114	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces_baseChange B' (Sum.inl j)).ge t)
115	  | inr j =>
116	      simpa only [BasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap, pieceSectionsMap,
117	        BasicOpenCoverData.pieces, BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange, Sum.elim_inr,
118	        relAffSectionsMap, Scheme.resHom_refl] using
119	        ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
120	          (le_rfl : D.pieces (Sum.inr j) ≤ D.pieces (Sum.inr j))
121	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' (Sum.inr j))
122	          (le_rfl : relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces (Sum.inr j) ≤
123	            relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces (Sum.inr j))
124	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces_baseChange B' (Sum.inr j)).ge t)

126	/-- The equation obtained by pulling back the canonical section-cut local equations is the
127	arbitrary-affine comparison of the selected datum component. -/
128	theorem pullbackEqn_sectionLocalEquations_eq_relAffSectionsMap
129	    [IsFinite pi] [IsNoetherianRing B]
130	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
131	    (s : ↑(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
132	    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
133	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
134	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
135	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] (z : relCurve C B') :
136	    Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C B B')
137	        (D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib) z =
138	      relAffSectionsMap C B'
139	        (D.pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base z)))
140	        (D.component s (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base z))) := by
141	  simp [Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn,
142	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular,
143	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionLocalEquations,
144	    relAffSectionsMap, Scheme.resHom]
145	
146	/-- Pulling back the divisor cut by a fibrewise-regular glued section is `DivEq` to the
147	divisor cut by the compared section on the canonical cover after an arbitrary affine
148	coefficient change.  The first comparison has unit `1` on the pulled cover; the second is
149	the transition-unit refinement supplied by `sectionLocalEquations_divEq_of_same_section`. -/
150	theorem pullback_sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular_divEq_sectionsMapTop
151	    [IsFinite pi] [IsNoetherianRing B]
152	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
153	    (s : ↑(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
154	    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
155	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
156	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
157	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] [IsNoetherianRing B']
158	    (hfib' : ∀ (j : (D.baseChange B').index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B'),
159	      Function.Injective
160	        ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B'
161	          ((D.baseChange B').component (D.sectionsMapTop B' s) j)).rTensor
162	            p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
163	    (hpull : ∀ (y z : relCurve C B')
164	      (hz : z ∈ ((D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib).cover.pullback
165	        (relCurveMap C B B')).opens y),
166	      ((relCurve C B').presheaf.germ
167	        (((D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib).cover.pullback
168	          (relCurveMap C B B')).opens y) z hz).hom
169	          (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C B B')
170	            (D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib) y) ∈
171	        nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B').presheaf.stalk z)) :
172	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
173	      ((D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib).pullback
174	        (relCurveMap C B B') hpull)
175	      ((D.baseChange B').sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular
176	        (D.sectionsMapTop B' s) hfib') := by
177	  let f := relCurveMap C B B'
178	  let W := D.pointedCover.pullback f
179	  let sigma : relCurve C B' → D.index := fun z => D.pieceIndex (f.base z)
180	  let hsigma : ∀ z : relCurve C B', W.opens z ≤ (D.baseChange B').pieces (sigma z) :=
181	    fun z => D.pullback_pointedCover_le B' z
182	  let s' := D.sectionsMapTop B' s
183	  let hreg' : ∀ (j : (D.baseChange B').index) (z : relCurve C B')
184	      (hz : z ∈ (D.baseChange B').pieces j),
185	      ((relCurve C B').presheaf.germ ((D.baseChange B').pieces j) z hz).hom
186	          ((D.baseChange B').component s' j) ∈
187	        nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B').presheaf.stalk z) :=
188	    fun j z hz =>
189	      (D.baseChange B').germ_component_mem_nonZeroDivisors s' j (hfib' j) z hz
190	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq.trans (d₂ :=
191	    (D.baseChange B').sectionLocalEquations s' W sigma hsigma hreg') ?_ ?_
192	  · refine ⟨W, (fun _ => le_rfl), (fun _ => le_rfl), fun z => ?_⟩
193	    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
194	    rw [Units.val_one, one_mul]
195	    simp only [Scheme.LocalEquations.pullback_eqn, sectionLocalEquations_eqn]
196	    rw [D.pullbackEqn_sectionLocalEquations_eq_relAffSectionsMap s hfib B' z]
197	    rw [D.component_sectionsMapTop B' s (sigma z)]
198	    apply congrArg ((relCurve C B').resHom _)
199	    exact (D.resHom_piecesMap_eq_relAffSectionsMap B' (sigma z)
200	      (D.component s (sigma z))).symm
201	  · simpa only [BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular,
202	      s', hreg'] using
203	      (D.baseChange B').sectionLocalEquations_divEq_of_same_section s'
204	        W (D.baseChange B').pointedCover sigma (D.baseChange B').pieceIndex
205	        hsigma (fun _ => le_rfl) hreg'
206

152	§1.2 steps 2–4 spend: `classDeg L` of the second factor is `classDeg k (chartTwistClass)`
153	by E-iv-alg, hence `m·d₁ − deg Z`.  A bare `∃ M` splitting would leave that unavailable. -/
154	theorem picEtAffineEquiv_map_chartTwistFactor_eq_unit
155	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] {L : Type u} [Field L] [Algebra k L]
156	    [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
157	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K)) (M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
158	    (hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ)
159	      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀))
160	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) :
161	    PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K
162	        (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C m Z) (overSpec k K)))
163	      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
164	          (M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) (chartTwistClass C m Z))) := by
165	  -- the twist factor's fibre at `L`: honest over `K`, then transported to `L`
166	  have hθ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K
167	        (thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C m Z) (overSpec k K)))
168	      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
169	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) (chartTwistClass C m Z))) := by
170	    rw [picEtAffineEquiv_thetaFamily_eq_unit_relPicMk C (chartTwistClass C m Z) K,
171	      show PicEtAff.map C L
172	            (PicEtAff.unit C K (relPicMk C (overSpec k K)
173	              (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k K) (chartTwistClass C m Z))))
174	          = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicAlgMap C (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K L)
175	              (relPicMk C (overSpec k K)
176	                (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k K) (chartTwistClass C m Z))))
177	        from PicEtAff.map_unit C L _]
178	    refine congrArg (PicEtAff.unit C L) ?_
179	    rw [relPicAlgMap_mk]
180	    refine congrArg (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)) ?_
181	    -- `relCurveMap C k K ∘ (base change K → L)` and `relCurveMap C k L` are the same
182	    -- whisker, since both are `C ◁ Spec` of the unique `k`-algebra map to `L`.
183	    rw [relCurveMap_base_comp C (K := K) (L := L), Scheme.CechPic.map_comp]
184	    rfl
185	  rw [map_mul, map_mul, hM₀, hθ, ← map_mul, ← map_mul]

187	/-! ## The introduction rule COV-1 uses
188	
189	Read the docstring of `isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness` before editing anything here: it
190	retracts a standing negative result of this lane, and the retraction is what makes the
191	corollaries possible. -/

193	variable (C) in
194	/-- **THE `IsSplitWitness` INTRODUCTION RULE — the one this lane recorded as impossible.**
195	
196	A presenting Čech class over a finite separable `L`, plus a witness divisor inside it, gives
197	`IsSplitWitness`.  Nothing here mentions `θ`, `Σ` or a twist; the twisted case is the
198	corollary below.
199	
200	**This RETRACTS the "no positional introduction rule exists" record** of
201	`Picard/Pic0ChartSplit.lean`'s closing note and of the memory item filed with it.  That
202	record was measured, and its measurement was right about what it tested — five variants, all
203	timing out at 1000000+ heartbeats:
204	
205	* `exact`/`refine` with all twelve components as ONE anonymous constructor;
206	* the witness clause pre-bundled as a `have`;
207	* either curve spelling normalised to the other;
208	* `(isSplitWitness_iff_exists_splitting_witness …).mpr` applied to the twelve-tuple;
209	* the trivial splitting `L := K`.
210	
211	What none of them tested is **staging the existentials**.  Introducing them one at a time —
212	eight `Exists.intro`s and a four-component tail — costs nothing at the DEFAULT 200000
213	heartbeat budget.  The diagnosis the old record gives is still correct: the anonymous
214	constructor makes Lean unify the seven instance slots *while `L` is still a metavariable*,
215	re-checking `(relCurve C L).CechPic` against `((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor` on each
216	attempted assignment.  Staging fixes `L` at the first step, so every later component is
217	checked against a closed type and the two spellings never race.
218	
219	**The transferable rule**, and it is stronger than the one it replaces: for a deep existential
220	over types-with-instances, `refine Exists.intro x ?_` repeatedly, rather than one tuple.  The
221	old advice ("restate the definition with one spelling") would have been a large refactor of a
222	co-signed definition; the actual fix is a tactic-level one.  Measured, not inferred: this
223	theorem's own body is the evidence, and the twisted corollary below consumes it. -/
224	theorem isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness
225	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] (ν : picEt C (overSpec k K))
226	    {L : Type u} [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
227	    [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
228	    (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
229	    (hM : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K ν)
230	      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M))
231	    (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor)
232	    (hW : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M)
233	    (hW1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1)) :
234	    IsSplitWitness C ν := by
235	  refine Exists.intro L ?_
236	  refine Exists.intro ‹Field L› ?_
237	  refine Exists.intro ‹Algebra k L› ?_
238	  refine Exists.intro ‹Algebra K L› ?_
239	  refine Exists.intro ‹IsScalarTower k K L› ?_
240	  refine Exists.intro ‹Module.Finite K L› ?_
241	  refine Exists.intro ‹Algebra.IsSeparable K L› ?_
242	  refine Exists.intro M ?_
243	  exact ⟨hM, W, hW, hW1⟩
244	
245	variable (C) in
246	/-- **The TRIVIAL splitting `L := K`** — the variant the predecessor record singled out as
247	"worth wanting" and reported as unelaborable.
248	
249	At a field where the class is *already* honest, no extension is needed: a witness divisor over
250	`K` itself certifies `IsSplitWitness`.  The record (I-0564) noted specifically that this one
251	"fails for elaboration reasons, NOT because the mathematics is wrong".  The mathematics was
252	indeed fine and the elaboration is fine too, once the existentials are staged — this is a
253	one-line corollary of the theorem above, at `L := K` with the identity instances.
254	
255	Why it matters beyond closing a record: this is the **reverse half of
256	`IsChartDatumPresentation`**, the one residue CHART-U(b) still carries.  The forward half needs
257	a presenting datum's fibre predicate to imply the split predicate; that direction is the one
258	this supplies, since a datum over the base gives an honest class at the fibre field with no
259	extension to find. -/
260	theorem isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness_self
261	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] (ν : picEt C (overSpec k K))
262	    (M : (relCurve C K).CechPic)
263	    (hM : PicEtAff.map C K (picEtAffineEquiv C K ν)
264	      = PicEtAff.unit C K (relPicMk C (overSpec k K) M))
265	    (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left).CurveDivisor)
266	    (hW : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K W = M)
267	    (hW1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.divisorSheaf K W) 1)) :
268	    IsSplitWitness C ν :=
269	  isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness C ν M hM W hW hW1
270	
271	variable (C) in
272	/-- **COV-1's introduction rule for `chartLocus` membership.**
273	
274	Given, at the fibre field `K = κ(t)`:
275	* a finite separable `L/K` and a Čech class `M₀` presenting the *untwisted* fibre class `μ`;
276	* a divisor `W` on `C_L` whose class is `M₀ · (twist class base-changed to L)` and whose
277	  `H¹` vanishes,
278	
279	the *twisted* class `μ · θ^m · Σ⁻¹` satisfies `IsSplitWitness`.  Both hypotheses are what
280	`w4-datb` §1.2 produces: the first at step 1 (`exists_splitting_of_picEt`), the second at
281	step 5 (the greedy drop of `RiemannRoch/CoverageDrop.lean`) once step 3 has chosen `m`
282	against the fibre's own vanishing bound.
283	
284	The twist is written in the `chartTwistClass` (collapsed) spelling, which is where the
285	degree bookkeeping happens; `chartTwist_eq_mul_thetaFamily_chartTwistClass` converts. -/
286	theorem isSplitWitness_of_witness_twistClass
287	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
288	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
289	    {L : Type u} [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
290	    [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
291	    (M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
292	    (hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ)
293	      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀))
294	    (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor)
295	    (hW : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W
296	      = M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) (chartTwistClass C m Z))
297	    (hW1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1)) :
298	    IsSplitWitness C (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C m Z) (overSpec k K)) :=
299	  isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness C _ _
300	    (picEtAffineEquiv_map_chartTwistFactor_eq_unit C μ M₀ hM₀ m Z) W hW hW1
301	
302	end
303	
304	end AlgebraicGeometry
