/-! ## §1. The cover of a `k`-test by its base change, as an `Over`-morphism -/

/-- The base change `T ×_k Spec k'` of a `k`-test `T`, regarded as a `k'`-test
via the second projection.

This is the object the descent step's classes live on: a class over `k'` is a
class on `T_{k'}` for the tests `T` of interest, and `§2` shows a `k`-class is
determined by its restriction here. -/
noncomputable abbrev baseTest (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
    Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k')) :=
  Over.mk (pullback.snd T.hom (specMapAlgebra k k'))

/-- **The covering morphism `T_{k'} ⟶ T`**, in the slice over `Spec k`.

Its underlying scheme map is exactly `pullback.fst`, which is the morphism
`Picard/EtaleFieldCover.lean` builds its covering sieve from — so the sheaf
axiom landed there applies to this morphism on the nose (checked by `rfl`:
`coverMap_left`). -/
noncomputable def coverMap (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
    (restrictTest k k').obj (baseTest (k' := k') T) ⟶ T :=
  Over.homMk (pullback.fst T.hom (specMapAlgebra k k'))
    (pullback.condition (f := T.hom) (g := specMapAlgebra k k'))

/-- The cover morphism's underlying scheme map **is** `pullback.fst`, definitionally.

This is the identification that lets `§2` feed
`Scheme.picEt_ext_of_pullback_agrees`, whose sieve is generated by
`Presieve.singleton (pullback.fst T.hom (specMapAlgebra k k'))`. -/
@[simp]
theorem coverMap_left (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
    (coverMap (k' := k') T).left = pullback.fst T.hom (specMapAlgebra k k') := rfl

/-! ## §2. The uniqueness half of the descent — PROVED -/

/-- **Restriction along `T_{k'} ⟶ T` is injective on `picEt`-classes.**

For a smooth proper curve `C` over an arbitrary field `k`, an arbitrary finite
separable `k'/k`, and an arbitrary `k`-test `T`: two classes in
`Pic_{(C/k)ét}(T)` that agree after restriction to `T ×_k Spec k'` are equal.

This is the *uniqueness* half of the descent step, and it is what makes a
descended class unique once one exists — so a consumer holding a single class,
rather than a compatible family, needs no separate uniqueness hypothesis.

**Where the content is, stated precisely.** The amalgamation property itself is
free: `Scheme.isSheafFor_picEt_of_mem` holds at *every* covering sieve of
`etaleTopologyOver k`, `⊤` included, because it is `PicSharp.etaleSheaf`'s own
`Sheaf.cond` pushed through the forgetful functor. What this lemma adds over
`Scheme.picEt_ext_of_pullback_agrees` is the reduction from that lemma's
*sieve-indexed* hypothesis — agreement after restriction along **every** arrow of
the generated sieve — to agreement along the **single** morphism `coverMap`. The
step is the factorisation: an arrow of the sieve factors through `pullback.fst`,
and lifting that factorisation to the slice over `Spec k` is where
`pullback.condition` is consumed.

**That the factorisation is not avoidable is measured, not assumed** — it is the
obvious refutation of this lemma ("the sheaf axiom gives injectivity directly, so
the hand proof is redundant"), so it was probed rather than argued. Two routes,
both `EXIT=1`:

* deriving it from the amalgamation statement
  (`Scheme.isSheafFor_picEt_pullback_presieve`) requires exhibiting a
  `Presieve.FamilyOfElements` on the *whole* sieve for which both classes are
  amalgamations, and constructing that family needs a value at every sieve arrow —
  i.e. the same factorisation, relocated;
* discharging the sieve-indexed goal from the single-morphism hypothesis with no
  factorisation work fails: `exact h`, `simpa using h`, `congrArg _ h` and `aesop`
  all leave the goal open (`aesop` reports exhaustive search).

So the content is the reduction, and only the reduction. Whoever re-checks this
should re-run those two probes rather than trust the paragraph.

**No hypothesis on `C(k)`** (`I-0491`), and none on `T`. The finite-separability
binders are inherited from the covering-sieve membership witness of
`Picard/EtaleFieldCover.lean`, which is where they are genuinely used; they are
*not* needed by the cross-base identification (`picEt_crossBaseIso` holds for an
arbitrary field extension). -/
theorem picEt_injective_restrict_baseTest
    [FiniteDimensional k k'] [Algebra.IsSeparable k k']
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    {t₁ t₂ : (picEt C).obj (Opposite.op T)}
    (h : (picEt C).map (coverMap (k' := k') T).op t₁
       = (picEt C).map (coverMap (k' := k') T).op t₂) :
    t₁ = t₂ := by
  refine AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.picEt_ext_of_pullback_agrees k' C T ?_
  intro W g hg
  rw [Sieve.overEquiv_symm_iff] at hg
  obtain ⟨Z, a, b, hb, hfac⟩ := hg
  cases hb
  -- `g` factors through `coverMap` in the slice over `Spec k`.
  have hgfac : g = (Over.homMk a (by
      rw [← Over.w g]
      simp only [restrictTest, Over.map_obj_hom, baseTest, Over.mk_hom, ← hfac]
      rw [Category.assoc]
      exact congrArg (a ≫ ·) pullback.condition.symm) :
        W ⟶ (restrictTest k k').obj (baseTest (k' := k') T))
      ≫ coverMap (k' := k') T := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change Over.Hom.left g = a ≫ pullback.fst T.hom (specMapAlgebra k k')
    exact hfac.symm
  rw [hgfac]
  simp only [op_comp, Functor.map_comp, CategoryTheory.comp_apply, h]

A representation of `picEt` of the **base-changed curve** `C_{k'}` by a

    {X' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k'))}

/-! ## §1. The `γ`-twist of a base-changed test -/

/-- `Spec γ : Spec k' ⟶ Spec k'`, the scheme map of a `k`-automorphism of `k'`. -/
noncomputable abbrev specGal (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    Spec (CommRingCat.of k') ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k') :=
  Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (γ : k' →+* k'))

/-- **`Spec γ` is a morphism over `Spec k`.**

This is `γ.commutes` — that `γ` fixes `k` — transported through `Spec`. It is the
only place the `k`-algebra structure of `γ` (as opposed to its being a ring
automorphism) is consumed, and everything else in this file is formal. -/
theorem specGal_comp (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    specGal γ ≫ specMapAlgebra k k' = specMapAlgebra k k' := by
  rw [specMapAlgebra, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  ext x
  exact γ.commutes x

/-- The `γ`-twist of `T ×_k Spec k'` on underlying schemes: the identity on the `T`
factor and `Spec γ` on the `Spec k'` factor.

Well defined because `Spec γ` is a morphism over `Spec k` (`specGal_comp`), so the
twisted pair still satisfies the pullback condition. -/
noncomputable def twistLeft (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    pullback T.hom (specMapAlgebra k k') ⟶ pullback T.hom (specMapAlgebra k k') :=
  pullback.lift (pullback.fst _ _) (pullback.snd _ _ ≫ specGal γ) (by
    rw [Category.assoc, specGal_comp]
    exact pullback.condition)

/-- **The `γ`-twist as an endomorphism of the base-changed test, in the slice over
`Spec k`.**

This is the morphism a `γ`-invariance hypothesis is a statement about. **The
scheme-level twist already existed and an earlier revision of this docstring denied
it** (`I-1455`): `twistLeft` is `rfl`-equal to
`AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent.pullbackGalMap k k' T.hom γ⁻¹`
(`Picard/FiniteGaloisQuotient.lean`, which also has the two projection identities
and the whole semilinear action). The denial was a census scoped to
`Picard/GaloisDescent/` reported as a fact about the project — literally true of the
directory, false of the tree, and exactly the trap that makes a lane rebuild a
landed construction. What this file adds is the **slice-over-`Spec k`** packaging,
which is what `picEt` consumes.

It is a slice morphism over `Spec k`, not over `Spec k'`: the twist moves the
`k'`-structure and is *not* `k'`-linear, which is exactly the semilinearity of the
Galois action, and is why the descent runs in the `k`-slice. -/
noncomputable def twistTest (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    (restrictTest k k').obj (baseTest (k' := k') T) ⟶
      (restrictTest k k').obj (baseTest (k' := k') T) :=
  Over.homMk (twistLeft T γ) (by
    change twistLeft T γ ≫ pullback.snd _ _ ≫ specMapAlgebra k k' = _
    rw [twistLeft, pullback.lift_snd_assoc, Category.assoc, specGal_comp]
    rfl)

/-- **The twist lives over `T`**: it commutes with the covering morphism.

This is what makes the twist a morphism of *descent data* rather than merely of
schemes, and it is `pullback.lift_fst` — the twist is the identity on the `T`
factor. -/
theorem twistTest_comp_coverMap (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    twistTest T γ ≫ coverMap (k' := k') T = coverMap (k' := k') T := by
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change twistLeft T γ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = pullback.fst _ _
  exact pullback.lift_fst _ _ _

/-! ## §2. The `γ`-component section of the cover's self-pullback -/

/-- **THE COHERENCE, as a morphism**: the `γ`-component
`T_{k'} ⟶ T_{k'} ×_T T_{k'}`, namely `⟨𝟙, twist γ⟩`.

`PicEtDescentExistence.lean` §4 named the open link as "the `Gal`-coproduct's
`γ`-component inclusion composed with the two projections gives `id` and `γ`", with
the ingredients listed as `pullbackSpecIso`, `IsIso (sigmaSpec …)` and
`galoisSelfTensorEquiv`. **None of those three is needed for the coherence itself.**
The section exists by the universal property of the pullback, from
`twistTest_comp_coverMap` alone, and the two identities below are
`pullback.lift_fst` and `pullback.lift_snd`. The splitting is needed for something
else — see §4.

No hypothesis on `k'/k` beyond `[Algebra k k']`. -/
noncomputable def coverSelfSection (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    (restrictTest k k').obj (baseTest (k' := k') T) ⟶
      pullback (coverMap (k := k) (k' := k') T) (coverMap (k := k) (k' := k') T) :=
  pullback.lift (𝟙 _) (twistTest T γ) (by
    rw [Category.id_comp, twistTest_comp_coverMap])

/-- The `γ`-component composed with the **first** projection is the identity. -/
@[simp] theorem coverSelfSection_fst (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    coverSelfSection T γ ≫ pullback.fst (coverMap (k := k) (k' := k') T)
      (coverMap (k := k) (k' := k') T) = 𝟙 _ :=
  pullback.lift_fst _ _ _

/-- The `γ`-component composed with the **second** projection is the `γ`-twist. -/
@[simp] theorem coverSelfSection_snd (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    coverSelfSection T γ ≫ pullback.snd (coverMap (k := k) (k' := k') T)
      (coverMap (k := k) (k' := k') T) = twistTest T γ :=
  pullback.lift_snd _ _ _

/-! ## §3. Agreement ⟹ invariance — free, and at full generality -/

/-- **The direction that is free: projection agreement gives `γ`-invariance, for
every `γ`.**

If a class `x` on `T_{k'}` has equal pullbacks along the two projections of
`T_{k'} ×_T T_{k'}`, then `x` is fixed by the `γ`-twist for every
`γ ∈ Gal(k'/k)` — hence `ajc-p2`'s hypothesis is *at least as strong as*
`γ`-invariance.

169	/-- The quasi-coherence packaging on the pinned chart `V₁ᴮ`, from the chart-1
170	family. -/
171	noncomputable instance instQcohOn₁ :
172	    Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ :=
173	  gluedQcohOn B D.pieces D.unit D.isGluingCocycle (σ := Sum.inr) (h := D.h₁)
174	    (fun _ => le_rfl) D.cover₁
175	
176	/-- The quasi-coherence packaging on the overlap of the pinned charts, from the
177	restricted chart-0 family (the subordinate-pieces interface). -/
178	noncomputable instance instQcohOnInf :
179	    Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf
180	      ((relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁) :=
181	  gluedQcohOn B D.pieces D.unit D.isGluingCocycle
182	    (σ := fun j : D.J₀ => Sum.inl j) (h := D.hInf)
183	    (fun j => D.basicOpen_hInf_le j) D.coverInf
184	
185	/-- **The two-cover pair data of the datum's glued sheaf** at the pinned relative chart
186	coordinates `t₀ᴮ, t₁ᴮ`: overlap-as-basic-open from the landed
187	`relCover_fiberTwoCover_inf_eq_basicOpen₀/₁`, mutual inverse from the pulled-back
188	`P1.chartCoord` relation `relFiberCoord_mul`. Its `pair` is the two-lattice pair of the
189	datum's sheaf that the rigid engine consumes. -/
190	noncomputable def pairData :
191	    Scheme.TwoCoverPairData D.sheaf (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
192	      (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ :=
193	  gluedPairData B D.pieces D.unit
194	    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)
195	    (relFiberCoord₀ C B π) (relFiberCoord₁ C B π)
196	    (relCover_fiberTwoCover_inf_eq_basicOpen₀ C B π)
197	    (relCover_fiberTwoCover_inf_eq_basicOpen₁ C B π)
198	    (relFiberCoord_mul C B π)
199	
200	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
201	
202	end AlgebraicGeometry

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.SectionsToDivisors
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafClass

9	/-!
10	# Sections to divisors — the LocalEquations construction and the class law (DAT-A)
11	
12	Worksheet §2.2 step 2, made literal (`informal/spec-dat-a.md` §3): a global section of
13	the DAT-1 glued sheaf **is** a matching family `(s_j)` with `s_i = g_{ij}·s_j`, so once
14	its components are germ-regular (DAT-A2, `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.SectionsToDivisors`)
15	it is a `Scheme.LocalEquations` datum on the nose. The (1e) class law
16	(`Cohomology/GluedSheafClass.lean`, landed while this brick was in flight) is consumed
17	directly — the spec's `cocycleClassOn` seam is CLOSED, no interim class carrier exists:
18	
19	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionLocalEquations` — the LocalEquations datum of a
20	  germ-regular global section on **any** pointed cover subordinated to the pieces
21	  (the (1e) subordination interface `𝒲, σ, hσ`): equations the restricted components
22	  `D.component s (σ y)`, ratio witnesses the subordinated transition units
23	  `gluedSubordUnit`;
24	* `sectionLocalEquations_ratioUnit` — the ratio units are **exactly** the (restricted)
25	  transition units of the cocycle (`ratioUnit_unique`); on the piece cover the
26	  restriction is along `≤`-reflexivity, i.e. the units themselves;
27	* `sectionLocalEquations_unitsCocycle` — the units cocycle of the constructed datum is
28	  the (1e) subordinated cocycle `gluedSubordCocycle`;
29	* **the class law** `sectionLocalEquations_picClass`:
30	  `(D.sectionLocalEquations …).picClass = D.cechPicClass` — the divisor datum cut out
31	  by a germ-regular section presents THE class of the datum's cocycle (the Abel
32	  correspondence), through the landed `cechPicClass_eq_mk`. Naturality under
33	  refinement/subordination-choice is the landed `gluedSubordCocycle_class_eq`; unit
34	  rescalings and cover refinements of the constructed datum keep the class by the
35	  landed `LocalEquations.picClass_rescale`/`picClass_restrict`;
36	* `sectionLocalEquations_picClass_congr` — any two germ-regular sections on any two
37	  subordinated covers cut divisors of the same class;
38	* `sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular` — the A2-bundled wrapper on the canonical
39	  pointed cover (`D.pointedCover`): a fibrewise-regular global section yields the
40	  divisor datum outright, with class `D.cechPicClass` (`[IsNoetherianRing B]`).
41	-/
42	
43	set_option autoImplicit false
44	
45	universe u
46	
47	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
48	
49	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
50	
51	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
52	
53	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule
54	
55	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
56	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
57	
58	/-- The value of a restricted unit section is the restriction of its value. -/
59	private lemma val_unitsRestrict {X : Scheme.{u}} {W U : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U)
60	    (u : Γ(X, U)ˣ) :
61	    ((X.unitsRestrict h u : Γ(X, W)ˣ) : Γ(X, W)) = X.resHom h (u : Γ(X, U)) :=
62	  rfl
63	
64	section AffineHom
65	
66	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
67	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
68	variable (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
69	variable (𝒲 : (relCurve C B).PointedCover) (σ : relCurve C B → D.index)
70	variable (hσ : ∀ y : relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens y ≤ D.pieces (σ y))
71	
72	/-- The defining ratio equation of the section's restricted components on the overlaps
73	of a subordinated pointed cover: the matching relation of the glued family, restricted
74	from `⊤ ⊓ Uᵢ ⊓ Uⱼ`. -/
75	private lemma component_ratio_eq (y y' : relCurve C B) :
76	    ((relCurve C B).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left :
77	        𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y' ≤ 𝒲.opens y)).op).hom
78	        ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y) (D.component s (σ y)))
79	      = (gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲 σ hσ y y' :
80	            Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y'))
81	        * ((relCurve C B).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right :
82	            𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y' ≤ 𝒲.opens y')).op).hom
83	            ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y') (D.component s (σ y'))) := by
84	  have hle : 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y'
85	      ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces (σ y) ⊓ D.pieces (σ y') :=
86	    le_inf (le_inf le_top (inf_le_left.trans (hσ y))) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y'))
87	  have key := congrArg ((relCurve C B).resHom hle) (s.property (σ y) (σ y'))
88	  rw [map_mul] at key
89	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
90	  change (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_left
91	      ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y) (D.component s (σ y)))
92	    = (gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲 σ hσ y y' :
93	        Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y'))
94	      * (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_right
95	          ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y') (D.component s (σ y')))
96	  rw [gluedSubordUnit, val_unitsRestrict, component, component]
97	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
98	  exact key
99	
100	/-- **Sections ↦ divisor families** (DAT-A, worksheet §2.2 step 2): a germ-regular
101	global section of the DAT-1 glued sheaf is a `Scheme.LocalEquations` datum on any
102	pointed cover subordinated to the pieces — the equations are the (restricted)
103	components, the ratio witnesses the subordinated transition units. Germ-regularity
104	(`hreg`) is DAT-A2's output (`germ_component_mem_nonZeroDivisors` relatively;
105	`Scheme.germ_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero` on an integral field-level curve). -/
106	noncomputable def sectionLocalEquations
107	    (hreg : ∀ (j : D.index) (y : relCurve C B) (hy : y ∈ D.pieces j),
108	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom (D.component s j)
109	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk y)) :
110	    (relCurve C B).LocalEquations where
111	  cover := 𝒲
112	  eqn y := (relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y) (D.component s (σ y))
113	  regular y z hz := by
114	    rw [Scheme.resHom, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
115	    exact hreg (σ y) z (hσ y hz)
116	  ratio_isUnit y y' :=
117	    ⟨gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲 σ hσ y y', D.component_ratio_eq s 𝒲 σ hσ y y'⟩
118	
119	variable (hreg : ∀ (j : D.index) (y : relCurve C B) (hy : y ∈ D.pieces j),
120	  ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom (D.component s j)
121	    ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk y))
122	
123	@[simp]
124	lemma sectionLocalEquations_cover :
125	    (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).cover = 𝒲 :=
126	  rfl
127	
128	@[simp]
129	lemma sectionLocalEquations_eqn (y : relCurve C B) :
130	    (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).eqn y
131	      = (relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y) (D.component s (σ y)) :=
132	  rfl
133	
134	/-- **The ratio units are exactly the cocycle's transition units** (worksheet §2.2 step
135	2's "ratio units EXACTLY the cocycle"), in subordinated form: by uniqueness of ratio
136	witnesses against a regular equation. On the piece cover the subordination is
137	`≤`-reflexivity and `gluedSubordUnit` is the transition unit restricted along it. -/
138	lemma sectionLocalEquations_ratioUnit (y y' : relCurve C B) :
139	    (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).ratioUnit y y'
140	      = gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲 σ hσ y y' :=
141	  ((D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).ratioUnit_unique y y'
142	    (gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲 σ hσ y y')
143	    (D.component_ratio_eq s 𝒲 σ hσ y y')).symm
144	
145	/-- The units cocycle of the constructed LocalEquations datum is the (1e) subordinated
146	cocycle of the datum. -/
147	lemma sectionLocalEquations_unitsCocycle :
148	    (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).unitsCocycle
149	      = gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle 𝒲 σ hσ :=
150	  Scheme.unitsCocycle_ext fun y y' =>
151	    ((D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).unitsCocycle_evInf y y').trans
152	      ((D.sectionLocalEquations_ratioUnit s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg y y').trans
153	        (gluedSubordCocycle_evInf D.isGluingCocycle 𝒲 σ hσ y y').symm)
154	
155	/-- **THE CLASS LAW** (DAT-A keystone; the Abel correspondence of worksheet §2.2 step
156	2): the Picard class of the divisor datum cut out by a germ-regular global section of
157	the DAT-1 glued sheaf is THE Čech Picard class of the datum's cocycle (stage (1e),
158	consumed on the nose through `cechPicClass_eq_mk`). -/
159	theorem sectionLocalEquations_picClass :
160	    (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).picClass = D.cechPicClass := by
161	  change Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲
162	    (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).unitsCocycle.class = D.cechPicClass
163	  rw [D.sectionLocalEquations_unitsCocycle s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg]
164	  exact D.cechPicClass_eq_mk 𝒲 σ hσ
165	
166	end AffineHom
167	
168	/-- **Independence of the section and the cover** (refinement/rescaling naturality,
169	subsumed): the class of the divisor datum cut by ANY germ-regular section of the datum,
170	on ANY subordinated pointed cover, is the same — both are `D.cechPicClass`. Unit
171	rescalings and cover refinements of the constructed datum keep the class by the landed
172	`LocalEquations.picClass_rescale`/`picClass_restrict`. -/
173	theorem sectionLocalEquations_picClass_congr
174	    {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π] (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
175	    (s s' : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
176	    (𝒲 𝒲' : (relCurve C B).PointedCover) (σ σ' : relCurve C B → D.index)
177	    (hσ : ∀ y : relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens y ≤ D.pieces (σ y))
178	    (hσ' : ∀ y : relCurve C B, 𝒲'.opens y ≤ D.pieces (σ' y))
179	    (hreg : ∀ (j : D.index) (y : relCurve C B) (hy : y ∈ D.pieces j),
180	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom (D.component s j)
181	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk y))
182	    (hreg' : ∀ (j : D.index) (y : relCurve C B) (hy : y ∈ D.pieces j),
183	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom (D.component s' j)
184	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk y)) :
185	    (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).picClass
186	      = (D.sectionLocalEquations s' 𝒲' σ' hσ' hreg').picClass := by
187	  rw [D.sectionLocalEquations_picClass s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg,
188	    D.sectionLocalEquations_picClass s' 𝒲' σ' hσ' hreg']
189	
190	/-! ## The A2-bundled wrapper, on the canonical pointed cover -/
191	
192	section Bundled
193	
194	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
195	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
196	
197	/-- **Fibrewise-nonzero sections cut divisors** (DAT-A + DAT-A2, bundled): over a
198	Noetherian test ring, a fibrewise-regular global section of the DAT-1 glued sheaf
199	yields a `LocalEquations` divisor datum on the canonical pointed cover by pieces; its
200	class is `D.cechPicClass` (`sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular_picClass`). -/
201	noncomputable def sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular
202	    [IsNoetherianRing B]
203	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
204	    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
205	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
206	    (relCurve C B).LocalEquations :=
207	  D.sectionLocalEquations s D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex (fun _ => le_rfl)
208	    (fun j y hy => D.germ_component_mem_nonZeroDivisors s j (hfib j) y hy)
209	
210	/-- The class law for the A2-bundled wrapper: the fibrewise-regular section cuts a
211	divisor of class exactly the datum's (1e) class. -/
212	theorem sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular_picClass
213	    [IsNoetherianRing B]
214	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
215	    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
216	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
217	    (D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib).picClass = D.cechPicClass :=
218	  D.sectionLocalEquations_picClass s D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex (fun _ => le_rfl) _
219	
220	end Bundled
221	
222	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
223	
224	end AlgebraicGeometry

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic
7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Pullbacks
8	
9	/-!
10	# The relative Picard functor of a curve
11	
12	For a scheme `C` over a field `k` (an object of `Over (Spec k)`) this file defines the
13	relative Picard functor of Grothendieck–Kleiman:
14	$$\operatorname{Pic}_{C/k}(T) \;=\; \operatorname{Pic}(C \times_k T)\,/\,
15	  \operatorname{Pic}(T),$$
16	line-bundle classes on `C ⊗ T` modulo classes pulled back from the test object `T`
17	along the second projection. The quotient — never the absolute `Pic(C ⊗ T)`, which is
18	not even a separated presheaf in any useful sense — is the functor that étale
19	sheafification and the representability theorem consume.
20	
21	Products are the cartesian-monoidal product of `Over (Spec k)` (chosen pullbacks of
22	schemes): `C ⊗ T`, projection `snd C T`, whiskering `C ◁ g`, matching the vocabulary
23	of the challenge statement file.
24	
25	## Main declarations
26	
27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.picFromBase C T`: the subgroup of `(C ⊗ T).left.CechPic` of classes
28	  pulled back from `T` along the second projection.
29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPic C T`: the relative Picard group, the quotient by
30	  `picFromBase C T`, a `CommGroup`; `relPicMk` is the projection, with
31	  `relPicMk_eq_relPicMk_iff` the exact coset relation (a genuine range condition, no
32	  choice, no `Nonempty (≅)`).
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPicMap C g`: restriction along `g : T' ⟶ T`, descended from
34	  pullback of Čech classes along `C ◁ g`.
35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPicFunctor C`: the relative Picard functor
36	  `(Over (Spec k))ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat`.
37	-/
38	
39	set_option autoImplicit false
40	
41	universe u
42	
43	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
44	open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme (CechPic)
45	
46	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
47	
48	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
49	
50	noncomputable section
51	
52	/-- The subgroup of Picard classes on `C ⊗ T` pulled back from the test object `T`
53	along the second projection. The relative Picard group is the quotient by it. -/
54	def picFromBase (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Subgroup ((C ⊗ T).left.CechPic) :=
55	  (CechPic.map (snd C T).left).range
56	
57	lemma mem_picFromBase_iff {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {L : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic} :
58	    L ∈ picFromBase C T ↔ ∃ N : T.left.CechPic, CechPic.map (snd C T).left N = L :=
59	  Iff.rfl
60	
61	/-- The relative Picard group of `C/k` at a test object `T`: Picard classes on `C ⊗ T`
62	modulo classes pulled back from `T`. -/
63	def relPic (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Type u :=
64	  (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic ⧸ picFromBase C T
65	
66	noncomputable instance (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : CommGroup (relPic C T) :=
67	  QuotientGroup.Quotient.commGroup (picFromBase C T)
68	
69	/-- The projection from Picard classes on `C ⊗ T` to the relative Picard group. -/
70	noncomputable def relPicMk (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
71	    (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic →* relPic C T :=
72	  QuotientGroup.mk' (picFromBase C T)
73	
74	lemma relPicMk_surjective (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
75	    Function.Surjective (relPicMk C T) :=
76	  QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (picFromBase C T)
77	
78	/-- The exact coset relation: two Picard classes on `C ⊗ T` have equal image in the
79	relative Picard group iff their ratio is pulled back from `T`. -/
80	lemma relPicMk_eq_relPicMk_iff {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
81	    {L L' : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic} :
82	    relPicMk C T L = relPicMk C T L' ↔ L / L' ∈ picFromBase C T :=
83	  QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem
84	
85	@[elab_as_elim]
86	theorem relPic.ind {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {motive : relPic C T → Prop}
87	    (mk : ∀ L : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic, motive (relPicMk C T L)) (x : relPic C T) :
88	    motive x :=
89	  QuotientGroup.induction_on x mk
90	
91	variable {T T' T'' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
92	
93	/-- Pullback of Čech Picard classes along `C ◁ g` sends classes from `T` to classes
94	from `T'`: the well-definedness of `relPicMap` on the `H_T`-cosets. -/
95	lemma picFromBase_le_comap (g : T' ⟶ T) :
96	    picFromBase C T ≤ (picFromBase C T').comap (CechPic.map (C ◁ g).left) := by
97	  rintro _ ⟨N, rfl⟩
98	  refine ⟨CechPic.map g.left N, ?_⟩
99	  show CechPic.map (snd C T').left (CechPic.map g.left N)
100	      = CechPic.map (C ◁ g).left (CechPic.map (snd C T).left N)
101	  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
102	    ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left, ← Over.comp_left, whiskerLeft_snd]
103	
104	/-- Restriction of relative Picard classes along `g : T' ⟶ T`: pull back along
105	`C ◁ g` and descend to the quotients. -/
106	noncomputable def relPicMap (g : T' ⟶ T) : relPic C T →* relPic C T' :=
107	  QuotientGroup.map (picFromBase C T) (picFromBase C T')
108	    (CechPic.map (C ◁ g).left) (picFromBase_le_comap C g)
109	
110	@[simp]
111	lemma relPicMap_mk (g : T' ⟶ T) (L : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic) :
112	    relPicMap C g (relPicMk C T L) = relPicMk C T' (CechPic.map (C ◁ g).left L) :=
113	  QuotientGroup.map_mk' _ _ _ _ L
114	
115	lemma relPicMap_id (x : relPic C T) : relPicMap C (𝟙 T) x = x := by
116	  induction x using relPic.ind with
117	  | mk L =>
118	    rw [relPicMap_mk, MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_id, Over.id_left,
119	      Scheme.CechPic.map_id]
120	    rfl
121	
122	lemma relPicMap_comp (g : T' ⟶ T) (h : T'' ⟶ T') (x : relPic C T) :
123	    relPicMap C (h ≫ g) x = relPicMap C h (relPicMap C g x) := by
124	  induction x using relPic.ind with
125	  | mk L =>
126	    rw [relPicMap_mk, relPicMap_mk, relPicMap_mk]
127	    refine congrArg (relPicMk C T'') ?_
128	    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left,
129	      ← MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp]
130	
131	/-- The relative Picard functor `T ↦ Pic(C ⊗ T)/Pic(T)` of Grothendieck–Kleiman, as a
132	presheaf of commutative groups on `Over (Spec k)`. -/
133	noncomputable def relPicFunctor : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat.{u} where
134	  obj T := CommGrpCat.of (relPic C T.unop)
135	  map g := CommGrpCat.ofHom (relPicMap C g.unop)
136	  map_id T := by
137	    ext x
138	    exact relPicMap_id C x
139	  map_comp g h := by
140	    ext x
141	    exact relPicMap_comp C g.unop h.unop x
142	
143	@[simp]
144	lemma relPicFunctor_obj (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) :
145	    (relPicFunctor C).obj T = CommGrpCat.of (relPic C T.unop) :=
146	  rfl
147	
148	@[simp]
149	lemma relPicFunctor_map {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ} (g : T ⟶ T')
150	    (x : relPic C T.unop) :
151	    (relPicFunctor C).map g x = relPicMap C g.unop x :=
152	  rfl
153	
154	/-! ## Naturality in the curve -/
155	
156	variable {C} {C' C'' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
157	
158	/-- Pullback of Čech classes along `g ▷ T` sends classes pulled back from `T` to classes
159	pulled back from `T`: well-definedness of the curve-direction map on the `H_T`-cosets. -/
160	lemma picFromBase_le_comap_whiskerRight (g : C' ⟶ C) (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
161	    picFromBase C T ≤ (picFromBase C' T).comap (CechPic.map (g ▷ T).left) := by
162	  rintro _ ⟨N, rfl⟩
163	  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
164	  show CechPic.map (snd C' T).left N
165	      = CechPic.map (g ▷ T).left (CechPic.map (snd C T).left N)
166	  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left,
167	    whiskerRight_snd]
168	
169	/-- Restriction of relative Picard classes along a morphism of curves `g : C' ⟶ C`,
170	at a fixed test object: pull back along `g ▷ T` and descend to the quotients. -/
171	noncomputable def relPicMapCurveApp (g : C' ⟶ C) (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
172	    relPic C T →* relPic C' T :=
173	  QuotientGroup.map (picFromBase C T) (picFromBase C' T)
174	    (CechPic.map (g ▷ T).left) (picFromBase_le_comap_whiskerRight g T)
175	
176	@[simp]
177	lemma relPicMapCurveApp_mk (g : C' ⟶ C) (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
178	    (L : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic) :
179	    relPicMapCurveApp g T (relPicMk C T L)
180	      = relPicMk C' T (CechPic.map (g ▷ T).left L) :=
181	  QuotientGroup.map_mk' _ _ _ _ L
182	
183	/-- Naturality of the relative Picard functor in the curve: a morphism of curves
184	`g : C' ⟶ C` induces a natural transformation `Pic_{C/k} ⟶ Pic_{C'/k}`. -/
185	noncomputable def relPicMapCurve (g : C' ⟶ C) :
186	    relPicFunctor C ⟶ relPicFunctor C' where
187	  app T := CommGrpCat.ofHom (relPicMapCurveApp g T.unop)
188	  naturality T T' t := by
189	    ext x
190	    induction x using relPic.ind with
191	    | mk L =>
192	      show relPicMapCurveApp g T'.unop (relPicMap C t.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L))
193	          = relPicMap C' t.unop (relPicMapCurveApp g T.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L))
194	      rw [relPicMap_mk, relPicMapCurveApp_mk, relPicMapCurveApp_mk, relPicMap_mk]
195	      refine congrArg (relPicMk C' T'.unop) ?_
196	      rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
197	        ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left, ← Over.comp_left, whisker_exchange]
198	
199	@[simp]
200	lemma relPicMapCurve_app_mk (g : C' ⟶ C) (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ)
201	    (L : (C ⊗ T.unop).left.CechPic) :
202	    (relPicMapCurve g).app T (relPicMk C T.unop L)
203	      = relPicMk C' T.unop (CechPic.map (g ▷ T.unop).left L) :=
204	  relPicMapCurveApp_mk g T.unop L
205	
206	/-- The curve-direction maps are strictly functorial: the identity morphism induces the
207	identity transformation. -/
208	lemma relPicMapCurve_id : relPicMapCurve (𝟙 C) = 𝟙 (relPicFunctor C) := by
209	  ext T x
210	  induction x using relPic.ind with
211	  | mk L =>
212	    show relPicMapCurveApp (𝟙 C) T.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L) = relPicMk C T.unop L
213	    rw [relPicMapCurveApp_mk, MonoidalCategory.id_whiskerRight, Over.id_left,
214	      Scheme.CechPic.map_id]
215	    rfl
216	
217	/-- The curve-direction maps are strictly functorial: composition of curve morphisms
218	goes to composition of the induced transformations (contravariantly). -/
219	lemma relPicMapCurve_comp (g' : C'' ⟶ C') (g : C' ⟶ C) :
220	    relPicMapCurve (g' ≫ g) = relPicMapCurve g ≫ relPicMapCurve g' := by
221	  ext T x
222	  induction x using relPic.ind with
223	  | mk L =>
224	    show relPicMapCurveApp (g' ≫ g) T.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L)
225	        = relPicMapCurveApp g' T.unop (relPicMapCurveApp g T.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L))
226	    rw [relPicMapCurveApp_mk, relPicMapCurveApp_mk, relPicMapCurveApp_mk]
227	    refine congrArg (relPicMk C'' T.unop) ?_
228	    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left,
229	      ← MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight]
230	
231	end
232	
233	end AlgebraicGeometry

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FiniteGaloisQuotient
7	
8	/-!
9	# The affine finite Galois quotient theorem (campaign `G2`, affine model)
10	
11	Let `L/K` be a finite Galois extension with group `Γ = Gal(L/K)` and let `A` be an
12	`L`-algebra with a semilinear `Γ`-action (`specSemilinearGalAction`, the affine model
13	of `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FiniteGaloisQuotient`).  This file proves the wave-2
14	milestone of campaign `G2`: `Spec (A^Γ) ⟶ Spec K` **is a finite Galois quotient** of
15	`Spec A` — the full `IsGaloisQuotient` predicate (`isGaloisQuotient_spec`) — by
16	Speiser descent only, never Noether invariant finiteness.
17	
18	## Structure of the proof
19	
20	1. **The base-change isomorphism** `Spec A^Γ ×_{Spec K} Spec L ≅ Spec A`
21	   (`affineQuotientPullbackIso`): mathlib's `pullbackSpecIso K (A^Γ) L` composed with
22	   the tensor-factor swap `Spec (A^Γ ⊗[K] L) ≅ Spec (L ⊗[K] A^Γ)` (the engine
23	   convention keeps the Galois-acted factor `L` on the **left**; the swap is where
24	   the two conventions are bridged) and with `Spec` of the Speiser descent
25	   isomorphism `descentAlgEquiv : L ⊗[K] A^Γ ≃ₐ[L] A`.  It is over `Spec L`
26	   (`affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom_specMap`) and `Γ`-equivariant
27	   (`isEquivariant_affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom`); equivariance through the swap is
28	   checked on the two pullback projections (`toSpecAut_hom_pullbackSpecLIso_inv`).
29	
30	2. **The `T`-points property for affine `T`**
31	   (`existsUnique_pullbackBaseChange_of_affine`): the scheme-level transport of the
32	   proved algebraic Hom property `affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv`, along the
33	   identification `T ×_{Spec K} Spec L ≅ Spec (L ⊗[K] B)` (`pullbackSpecLIso`) for
34	   `T = Spec B`.  The workhorse `pullbackBaseChange_comp_affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom`
35	   computes the base change of any `u : Spec B ⟶ Spec A^Γ` over `Spec K` through the
36	   descent isomorphism as `Spec` of `extendScalarsAlgHom` of its algebra map.
37	
38	3. **The `T`-points property for all schemes `T`**: uniqueness globalizes first from
39	   an affine open cover (`affineQuotient_hom_unique` — morphisms of schemes are
40	   determined on an open cover, and on each affine piece the affine `∃!` applies);
41	   existence then glues the local affine solutions via `Scheme.Cover.glueMorphisms`,
42	   with agreement on the (possibly non-affine) overlaps supplied by the globalized
43	   uniqueness.  This order breaks the apparent circularity: overlap pieces of an
44	   affine cover of a non-separated `T` need not be affine.
45	
46	The gate `HasGaloisQuotient` is instance-free **only off the affine locus** now: this
47	file's theorem was generalised from the affine *model* to every affine total space in
48	`Picard/GaloisQuotientAffineGeneral.lean`, whose `hasGaloisQuotient_of_isAffine` is a
49	global instance. The residue is the non-affine case, where the Hironaka trap bites (see
50	the module docstring of `FiniteGaloisQuotient`). The affine-model theorem proved here is
51	legitimately unconditional because `Spec A` *is* a single `Γ`-stable affine chart.
52	**`HasStableAffineCover` is no longer instance-free** — `G2(a)` was discharged
53	after this sentence was written, and `StableAffineCover.lean:279` derives it as a
54	global instance from `[ρ.OrbitsInAffineOpen]` (measured `review-ajc`, 2026-07-29:
55	`infer_instance` succeeds for an abstract `ρ` with the orbit hypothesis, fails
56	without it).
57	
58	Campaign reference: `G2` of `informal/pic-representability-campaign.md` (Kleiman,
59	*The Picard scheme* §4; Milne, *Jacobian Varieties* §4; the affine heart is Speiser's
60	theorem, `SemilinearAlgebras.descentAlgEquiv`).
61	-/

63	universe u

65	open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry
66	open scoped TensorProduct
67	
68	namespace AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
69	
70	open SemilinearAction
71	
72	variable (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]

74	/-! ## `Spec` of a ring equivalence -/
75	
76	section SpecRingEquivIso
77	
78	/-- The isomorphism of spectra induced by a ring equivalence `ψ : S ≃+* T`.  By the
79	contravariance of `Spec`, the *hom* `Spec S ⟶ Spec T` is `Spec.map` of `ψ.symm`. -/
80	noncomputable def specRingEquivIso {S T : Type u} [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
81	    (ψ : S ≃+* T) : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of T) where
82	  hom := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (ψ.symm : T →+* S))
83	  inv := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (ψ : S →+* T))
84	  hom_inv_id := by
85	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
86	      show ((ψ.symm : T →+* S).comp (ψ : S →+* T)) = RingHom.id S from
87	        RingHom.ext fun s => ψ.symm_apply_apply s,
88	      CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id]
89	  inv_hom_id := by
90	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
91	      show ((ψ : S →+* T).comp (ψ.symm : T →+* S)) = RingHom.id T from
92	        RingHom.ext fun t => ψ.apply_symm_apply t,
93	      CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id]
94	
95	@[simp] lemma specRingEquivIso_hom {S T : Type u} [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
96	    (ψ : S ≃+* T) :
97	    (specRingEquivIso ψ).hom = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (ψ.symm : T →+* S)) := rfl
98	
99	@[simp] lemma specRingEquivIso_inv {S T : Type u} [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
100	    (ψ : S ≃+* T) :
101	    (specRingEquivIso ψ).inv = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (ψ : S →+* T)) := rfl
102	
103	end SpecRingEquivIso
104	
105	/-! ## Composition calculus for `pullbackBaseChange` -/
106	
107	section BaseChangeCalculus
108	
109	/-- Base change is functorial: the base change of a composite of morphisms over
110	`Spec K` is the composite of the base changes. -/
111	@[reassoc]
112	lemma pullbackBaseChange_comp {T' T Y : Scheme.{u}}
113	    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
114	    (t' : T' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (u : T ⟶ Y) (hu : u ≫ g = t)
115	    (v : T' ⟶ T) (hv : v ≫ t = t') :
116	    pullbackBaseChange K L g t' (v ≫ u) (by rw [Category.assoc, hu, hv])
117	      = pullbackBaseChange K L t t' v hv ≫ pullbackBaseChange K L g t u hu := by
118	  apply pullback.hom_ext <;> simp
119	
120	/-- `pullbackBaseChange` only depends on the underlying morphism. -/
121	lemma pullbackBaseChange_congr {T Y : Scheme.{u}}
122	    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
123	    {u u' : T ⟶ Y} (huu' : u = u') (hu : u ≫ g = t) :
124	    pullbackBaseChange K L g t u hu = pullbackBaseChange K L g t u' (huu' ▸ hu) := by
125	  subst huu'; rfl
126	
127	end BaseChangeCalculus
128	
129	/-- `Spec` of a `K`-algebra map is a morphism over `Spec K`. -/
130	lemma specMap_algHom_comp {C D : Type u} [CommRing C] [CommRing D] [Algebra K C]
131	    [Algebra K D] (φ : C →ₐ[K] D) :
132	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)
133	        ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K C))
134	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K D)) := by
135	  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
136	  congr 2
137	  exact φ.comp_algebraMap

139	/-! ## The base change of an affine scheme, in engine order `L ⊗[K] ·` -/
140	
141	section PullbackSpecLIso
142	
143	variable (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra K C]
144	
145	/-- For affine `T = Spec C` over `Spec K`, the base change `T ×_{Spec K} Spec L` is
146	`Spec (L ⊗[K] C)`, with the tensor factors in the engine order (the Galois-acted
147	factor `L` on the **left**): mathlib's `pullbackSpecIso` composed with the factor
148	swap `Algebra.TensorProduct.comm`. -/
149	noncomputable def pullbackSpecLIso :
150	    pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K C)))
151	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
152	      ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of (L ⊗[K] C)) :=
153	  pullbackSpecIso K C L ≪≫
154	    specRingEquivIso (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm K C L).toRingEquiv
155	
156	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
157	lemma pullbackSpecLIso_inv_fst :
158	    (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).inv ≫ pullback.fst _ _
159	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
160	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : C →ₐ[K] L ⊗[K] C).toRingHom) := by
161	  simp only [pullbackSpecLIso, Iso.trans_inv, specRingEquivIso_inv]
162	  rw [Category.assoc, pullbackSpecIso_inv_fst, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
163	  congr 2
164	
165	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
166	lemma pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd :
167	    (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).inv ≫ pullback.snd _ _
168	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] C))) := by
169	  simp only [pullbackSpecLIso, Iso.trans_inv, specRingEquivIso_inv]
170	  rw [Category.assoc, pullbackSpecIso_inv_snd, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
171	  congr 2
172	
173	/-- Equivariance of `pullbackSpecLIso`, inverse form: the `toSpecAut` action of `γ`
174	on `Spec (L ⊗[K] C)` (left-factor Galois action) corresponds to the canonical
175	base-change action `pullbackGalMap` on `Spec C ×_{Spec K} Spec L`. -/
176	lemma toSpecAut_hom_pullbackSpecLIso_inv (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
177	    (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) (L ⊗[K] C) γ).hom ≫ (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).inv
178	      = (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).inv
179	          ≫ pullbackGalMap K L (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K C))) γ := by
180	  apply pullback.hom_ext
181	  · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, pullbackGalMap_fst, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_fst,
182	      toSpecAut_hom, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
183	    congr 2
184	    ext c
185	    change γ⁻¹ • ((1 : L) ⊗ₜ[K] c) = (1 : L) ⊗ₜ[K] c
186	    rw [galTensor_smul_def]
187	    simp
188	  · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, pullbackGalMap_snd,
189	      pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd_assoc, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd, toSpecAut_hom,
190	      toSpecAut_hom, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
191	      ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
192	    congr 2
193	
194	/-- Equivariance of `pullbackSpecLIso`, hom form. -/
195	lemma pullbackGalMap_pullbackSpecLIso_hom (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
196	    pullbackGalMap K L (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K C))) γ
197	        ≫ (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).hom
198	      = (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).hom ≫ (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) (L ⊗[K] C) γ).hom := by
199	  rw [← cancel_epi (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).inv, ← Category.assoc,
200	    ← toSpecAut_hom_pullbackSpecLIso_inv, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
201	    Category.comp_id, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
202	
203	/-- Naturality of `pullbackSpecLIso` in the affine base: the base change of `Spec`
204	of a `K`-algebra map `φ : C →ₐ[K] D` corresponds to `Spec (id_L ⊗ φ)`. -/
205	lemma pullbackSpecLIso_inv_pullbackBaseChange {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [Algebra K D]
206	    (φ : C →ₐ[K] D) :
207	    (pullbackSpecLIso K L D).inv
208	        ≫ pullbackBaseChange K L (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K C)))
209	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K D)))
210	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)) (specMap_algHom_comp K φ)
211	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
212	            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id L L) φ).toRingHom)
213	        ≫ (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).inv := by
214	  apply pullback.hom_ext
215	  · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, pullbackBaseChange_fst,
216	      pullbackSpecLIso_inv_fst_assoc, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_fst, ← Spec.map_comp,
217	      ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
218	    congr 2
219	  · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, pullbackBaseChange_snd,
220	      pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd, ← Spec.map_comp,
221	      ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
222	    congr 2
223	    ext a
224	    change algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] D) a
225	      = Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id L L) φ (algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] C) a)
226	    change a ⊗ₜ[K] (1 : D) = Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id L L) φ (a ⊗ₜ[K] (1 : C))
227	    simp
228	
229	end PullbackSpecLIso
230	
231	/-! ## The equivariant base-change isomorphism `Spec A^Γ ×_{Spec K} Spec L ≅ Spec A` -/
232	
233	section AffineGaloisQuotient
234	
235	variable (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra K A] [Algebra L A] [IsScalarTower K L A]
236	variable [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A] [IsSemilinear K L A]
237	variable [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
238	
239	omit [Algebra K A] [IsScalarTower K L A] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] in
240	@[simp] lemma specSemilinearGalAction_act (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
241	    (specSemilinearGalAction K L A).act γ = toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A γ := rfl
242	
243	/-- **The `Γ`-equivariant base-change isomorphism** (Speiser descent, `Spec` form):
244	`Spec (A^Γ) ×_{Spec K} Spec L ≅ Spec A`, the composite of `pullbackSpecLIso` with
245	`Spec` of the descent isomorphism `L ⊗[K] A^Γ ≃ₐ[L] A`. -/
246	noncomputable def affineQuotientPullbackIso :
247	    pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
248	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
249	      ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A) :=
250	  pullbackSpecLIso K L (invariantsSubalgebra K L A) ≪≫
251	    specRingEquivIso (descentAlgEquiv K L A).toRingEquiv
252	
253	/-- The descent isomorphism is a morphism over `Spec L` (inverse form). -/
254	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
255	theorem affineQuotientPullbackIso_inv_snd :
256	    (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).inv ≫ pullback.snd _ _
257	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L A)) := by
258	  simp only [affineQuotientPullbackIso, Iso.trans_inv, specRingEquivIso_inv]
259	  rw [Category.assoc, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd, ← Spec.map_comp,
260	    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
261	  congr 2
262	  ext a
263	  exact (descentAlgEquiv K L A).commutes a
264	
265	/-- The quotient projection underlying the named base-change isomorphism is the

315	/-- The base change of `Spec` of a `K`-algebra map `φ : A^Γ →ₐ[K] B`, composed with
316	the descent isomorphism, is `Spec` of `extendScalarsAlgHom φ : A →ₐ[L] L ⊗[K] B`
317	read through `pullbackSpecLIso`.  Scheme-level form of the forward direction of
318	`invariantAlgHomEquiv`. -/
319	theorem pullbackBaseChange_specMap_algHom_comp_hom
320	    (φ : invariantsSubalgebra K L A →ₐ[K] B) :
321	    pullbackBaseChange K L
322	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
323	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B)))
324	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)) (specMap_algHom_comp K φ)
325	      ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
326	      = (pullbackSpecLIso K L B).hom
327	          ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (extendScalarsAlgHom K L A B φ).toRingHom) := by
328	  rw [← Iso.inv_comp_eq]
329	  simp only [affineQuotientPullbackIso, Iso.trans_hom]
330	  rw [← Category.assoc, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_pullbackBaseChange K L _ φ,
331	    Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, specRingEquivIso_hom, ← Spec.map_comp,
332	    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
333	  congr 2

335	/-- The value of `affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv` is `Spec` of `extendScalarsAlgHom` of
336	the corresponding algebra map (definitional unfolding). -/
337	lemma affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv_apply_coe
338	    (u : {u : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ⟶
339	        Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)) //
340	      u ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)))
341	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B))}) :
342	    (affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv K L A B u).1
343	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (extendScalarsAlgHom K L A B
344	          (specOverEquivAlgHom K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A) B u)).toRingHom) := rfl
345	
346	/-- The base change of any morphism `Spec B ⟶ Spec A^Γ` over `Spec K`, composed with
347	the descent isomorphism, computes as the corresponding equivariant morphism
348	`Spec (L ⊗[K] B) ⟶ Spec A` of `affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv`, read through
349	`pullbackSpecLIso`. -/
350	theorem pullbackBaseChange_comp_affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom
351	    (u : {u : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ⟶
352	        Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)) //
353	      u ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)))
354	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B))}) :
355	    pullbackBaseChange K L
356	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
357	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B))) u.1 u.2
358	      ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
359	      = (pullbackSpecLIso K L B).hom ≫ (affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv K L A B u).1 := by
360	  have hu1 : u.1 = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
361	      (specOverEquivAlgHom K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A) B u).toRingHom) :=
362	    congrArg Subtype.val
363	      ((specOverEquivAlgHom K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A) B).symm_apply_apply u).symm
364	  rw [pullbackBaseChange_congr K L _ _ hu1,
365	    pullbackBaseChange_specMap_algHom_comp_hom, affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv_apply_coe]

367	/-- **The `T`-points property of the affine Galois quotient, affine `T`** (campaign
368	`G2(b)`, `∃!` form): for affine `T = Spec B` over `Spec K`, every `Γ`-equivariant
369	morphism `T ×_{Spec K} Spec L ⟶ Spec A` over `Spec L` descends uniquely through the
370	descent isomorphism to `T ⟶ Spec (A^Γ)` over `Spec K`.  Speiser descent
371	(`affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv`), never Noether invariant finiteness. -/
372	theorem existsUnique_pullbackBaseChange_of_affine
373	    (t : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
374	    (ht : t = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B)))
375	    (h : pullback t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
376	      ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
377	    (hover : h ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L A)) = pullback.snd _ _)
378	    (hequiv : (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L t).IsEquivariant
379	      (specSemilinearGalAction K L A) h) :
380	    ∃! u : {u : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ⟶
381	        Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)) //
382	      u ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))) = t},
383	      pullbackBaseChange K L
384	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
385	          t u.1 u.2
386	        ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom = h := by
387	  subst ht
388	  have hover' : ((pullbackSpecLIso K L B).inv ≫ h)
389	      ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L A))
390	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] B))) := by
391	    rw [Category.assoc, hover, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd]
392	  have hequiv' : ∀ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
393	      (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) (L ⊗[K] B) γ).hom ≫ ((pullbackSpecLIso K L B).inv ≫ h)
394	        = ((pullbackSpecLIso K L B).inv ≫ h) ≫ (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A γ).hom := by
395	    intro γ
396	    have h1 := hequiv γ
397	    rw [pullbackSemilinearGalAction_act_hom, specSemilinearGalAction_act] at h1
398	    rw [← Category.assoc, toSpecAut_hom_pullbackSpecLIso_inv, Category.assoc,
399	      Category.assoc, h1]
400	  set w := (affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv K L A B).symm
401	      ⟨(pullbackSpecLIso K L B).inv ≫ h, hover', hequiv'⟩ with hwdef
402	  have hclause : pullbackBaseChange K L
403	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
404	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B))) w.1 w.2
405	      ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom = h := by
406	    rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp_affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom, hwdef,
407	      Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
408	    exact Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc _ _
409	  refine ⟨w, hclause, fun y hy => ?_⟩
410	  replace hy : pullbackBaseChange K L
411	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
412	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B))) y.1 y.2
413	      ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom = h := hy
414	  apply (affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv K L A B).injective
415	  apply Subtype.ext
416	  rw [hwdef, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
417	  change (affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv K L A B y).1 = (pullbackSpecLIso K L B).inv ≫ h
418	  rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp_affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom] at hy
419	  rw [← hy, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

421	/-! ## Globalized uniqueness -/
422	
423	/-- **Globalized uniqueness of the descended morphism**: for *any* scheme `T` over
424	`Spec K`, two morphisms `T ⟶ Spec (A^Γ)` over `Spec K` with the same base change
425	through the descent isomorphism are equal.  Restrict to an affine open cover and
426	apply the uniqueness clause of the affine `∃!`; morphisms of schemes are determined
427	by their restrictions to an open cover. -/
428	theorem affineQuotient_hom_unique {T : Scheme.{u}}
429	    {t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
430	    {u₁ u₂ : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))}
431	    (hu₁ : u₁ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
432	      (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))) = t)
433	    (hu₂ : u₂ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
434	      (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))) = t)
435	    (heq : pullbackBaseChange K L _ t u₁ hu₁ ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
436	      = pullbackBaseChange K L _ t u₂ hu₂ ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom) :
437	    u₁ = u₂ := by
438	  apply T.affineOpenCover.openCover.hom_ext
439	  change ∀ i : T.affineOpenCover.I₀,
440	    T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ u₁ = T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ u₂
441	  intro i
442	  letI : Algebra K ↥(T.affineOpenCover.X i) :=
443	    ((Spec.preimage (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t)).hom).toAlgebra
444	  have ht : T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t
445	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K ↥(T.affineOpenCover.X i))) := by
446	    rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, CommRingCat.ofHom_hom, Spec.map_preimage]
447	  -- `@`-application: re-synthesis of `Algebra K ↥(𝒜.X i)` diverges (the instance
448	  -- search unfolds the affine-cover choice term), so pass the `letI` explicitly.
449	  have hEU := @existsUnique_pullbackBaseChange_of_affine K L _ _ _ A _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
450	    ↥(T.affineOpenCover.X i) _ this
451	    (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) ht
452	    (pullbackBaseChange K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl
453	      ≫ pullbackBaseChange K L _ t u₁ hu₁ ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom)
454	    (by
455	      rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom_specMap,
456	        pullbackBaseChange_snd]
457	      exact pullbackBaseChange_snd K L t _ (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl)
458	    (SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp t _
459	      (specSemilinearGalAction K L A)
460	      (SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp _ t
461	        (specSemilinearGalAction K L A)
462	        (isEquivariant_affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom K L A) u₁ hu₁)
463	      (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl)
464	  have h₁ : pullbackBaseChange K L
465	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
466	        (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ u₁)
467	        (by rw [Category.assoc, hu₁])
468	      ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
469	      = pullbackBaseChange K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl
470	        ≫ pullbackBaseChange K L _ t u₁ hu₁ ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom := by
471	    rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp K L _ t _ u₁ hu₁ (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl,
472	      Category.assoc]
473	  have h₂ : pullbackBaseChange K L
474	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
475	        (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ u₂)
476	        (by rw [Category.assoc, hu₂])
477	      ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
478	      = pullbackBaseChange K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl
479	        ≫ pullbackBaseChange K L _ t u₁ hu₁ ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom := by
480	    rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp K L _ t _ u₂ hu₂ (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl,
481	      Category.assoc, heq]
482	  exact congrArg Subtype.val
483	    (hEU.unique (y₁ := ⟨T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ u₁, by rw [Category.assoc, hu₁]⟩)
484	      (y₂ := ⟨T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ u₂, by rw [Category.assoc, hu₂]⟩) h₁ h₂)
485	
486	/-! ## The fixed-isomorphism universal property and the main theorem -/
487	
488	/-- **The universal `T`-points property for the named affine quotient
489	isomorphism** `affineQuotientPullbackIso`.
490	
491	This is clause 3 of `isGaloisQuotient_spec`, exposed before it is packaged into
492	the proposition-valued `IsGaloisQuotient`.  Open restriction needs the equation
493	against this particular isomorphism: choosing an arbitrary existential witness
494	from the packaged predicate could twist the resulting quotient projection by an
495	automorphism. -/
496	theorem affineQuotient_existsUnique (T : Scheme.{u})
497	    (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
498	    (h : pullback t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ⟶
499	      Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
500	    (hover : h ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L A)) =
501	      pullback.snd t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))))
502	    (hequiv : (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L t).IsEquivariant
503	      (specSemilinearGalAction K L A) h) :
504	    ∃! u : {u : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)) //
505	        u ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
506	          (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))) = t},
507	      pullbackBaseChange K L
508	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
509	            (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)))) t u.1 u.2 ≫
510	        (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom = h := by
511	  -- local affine solutions on the pieces of an affine open cover
512	  have hloc : ∀ i : T.affineOpenCover.I₀,
513	      ∃ u : {u : Spec (T.affineOpenCover.X i) ⟶
514	          Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)) //
515	        u ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)))
516	          = T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t},
517	        pullbackBaseChange K L
518	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
519	            (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) u.1 u.2
520	          ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
521	        = pullbackBaseChange K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t)
522	            (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl ≫ h := by
523	    intro i
524	    letI : Algebra K ↥(T.affineOpenCover.X i) :=
525	      ((Spec.preimage (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t)).hom).toAlgebra
526	    have ht : T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t
527	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K ↥(T.affineOpenCover.X i))) := by
528	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, CommRingCat.ofHom_hom, Spec.map_preimage]
529	    -- `@`-application: see `affineQuotient_hom_unique` (instance-diamond dodge)
530	    exact (@existsUnique_pullbackBaseChange_of_affine K L _ _ _ A _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
531	      ↥(T.affineOpenCover.X i) _ this
532	      (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) ht
533	      (pullbackBaseChange K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl
534	        ≫ h)
535	      (by
536	        rw [Category.assoc, hover]
537	        exact pullbackBaseChange_snd K L t _ (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl)
538	      (SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp t _
539	        (specSemilinearGalAction K L A) hequiv (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl)).exists
540	  choose v hv using hloc
541	  -- the local solutions agree on overlaps, by the globalized uniqueness
542	  have hglue : ∀ i j : T.affineOpenCover.I₀,
543	      pullback.fst (T.affineOpenCover.f i) (T.affineOpenCover.f j) ≫ (v i).1
544	        = pullback.snd _ _ ≫ (v j).1 := by
545	    intro i j
546	    have hsnd : pullback.snd (T.affineOpenCover.f i) (T.affineOpenCover.f j)
547	          ≫ (T.affineOpenCover.f j ≫ t)
548	        = pullback.fst (T.affineOpenCover.f i) (T.affineOpenCover.f j)
549	            ≫ (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) := by
550	      rw [← Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, Category.assoc]
551	    have hi : pullbackBaseChange K L
552	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
553	          (pullback.fst (T.affineOpenCover.f i) (T.affineOpenCover.f j)
554	            ≫ (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t))
555	          (pullback.fst _ _ ≫ (v i).1) (by rw [Category.assoc, (v i).2])
556	        ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
557	        = pullbackBaseChange K L t _
558	            (pullback.fst _ _ ≫ T.affineOpenCover.f i) (Category.assoc _ _ _) ≫ h := by
559	      rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp_assoc K L _ (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) _ (v i).1
560	          (v i).2 (pullback.fst _ _) rfl,
561	        pullbackBaseChange_comp_assoc K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) _
562	          (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl (pullback.fst _ _) rfl, hv i]
563	    have hj : pullbackBaseChange K L
564	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
565	          (pullback.fst (T.affineOpenCover.f i) (T.affineOpenCover.f j)
566	            ≫ (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t))
567	          (pullback.snd _ _ ≫ (v j).1) (by rw [Category.assoc, (v j).2]; exact hsnd)
568	        ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
569	        = pullbackBaseChange K L t _
570	            (pullback.snd _ _ ≫ T.affineOpenCover.f j)
571	            (by rw [Category.assoc]; exact hsnd) ≫ h := by
572	      rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp_assoc K L _ (T.affineOpenCover.f j ≫ t) _ (v j).1
573	          (v j).2 (pullback.snd _ _) hsnd,
574	        pullbackBaseChange_comp_assoc K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f j ≫ t) _
575	          (T.affineOpenCover.f j) rfl (pullback.snd _ _) hsnd, hv j]
576	    have hcongr : pullbackBaseChange K L t
577	          (pullback.fst (T.affineOpenCover.f i) (T.affineOpenCover.f j)
578	            ≫ (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t))
579	          (pullback.fst _ _ ≫ T.affineOpenCover.f i) (Category.assoc _ _ _)
580	        = pullbackBaseChange K L t _
581	            (pullback.snd _ _ ≫ T.affineOpenCover.f j)
582	            (by rw [Category.assoc]; exact hsnd) :=
583	      pullbackBaseChange_congr K L t _ pullback.condition _
584	    exact affineQuotient_hom_unique K L A (by rw [Category.assoc, (v i).2])
585	      (by rw [Category.assoc, (v j).2]; exact hsnd)
586	      (hi.trans (by rw [hcongr]; exact hj.symm))
587	  -- glue the local solutions
588	  set w : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)) :=
589	    T.affineOpenCover.openCover.glueMorphisms (fun i => (v i).1) hglue with hw
590	  have hι : ∀ i, T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ w = (v i).1 := fun i =>
591	    T.affineOpenCover.openCover.ι_glueMorphisms (fun i => (v i).1) hglue i
592	  have hwt : w ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
593	      (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))) = t := by
594	    apply T.affineOpenCover.openCover.hom_ext
595	    change ∀ i : T.affineOpenCover.I₀,
596	      T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ w ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
597	        (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))) = T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t
598	    intro i
599	    rw [← Category.assoc, hι i, (v i).2]
600	  have hmain : pullbackBaseChange K L
601	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
602	      t w hwt ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom = h := by
603	    apply (Scheme.Pullback.openCoverOfLeft T.affineOpenCover.openCover t
604	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).hom_ext
605	    change ∀ i : T.affineOpenCover.I₀,
606	      pullbackBaseChange K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl
607	        ≫ (pullbackBaseChange K L
608	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
609	            t w hwt ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom)
610	      = pullbackBaseChange K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t)
611	          (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl ≫ h
612	    intro i
613	    rw [← Category.assoc,
614	      ← pullbackBaseChange_comp K L _ t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) w hwt
615	        (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl,
616	      pullbackBaseChange_congr K L _ (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (hι i) _, hv i]
617	  exact ⟨⟨w, hwt⟩, hmain, fun y hy => Subtype.ext
618	    (affineQuotient_hom_unique K L A y.2 hwt (hy.trans hmain.symm))⟩

620	/-- **The affine finite Galois quotient theorem** (campaign `G2`, wave-2 milestone):
621	for the affine model `specSemilinearGalAction` of a semilinear `Gal(L/K)`-action on
622	`Spec A`, the canonical morphism `Spec (A^Γ) ⟶ Spec K` is a finite Galois quotient —
623	the full `IsGaloisQuotient` predicate: the `Γ`-equivariant base-change isomorphism
624	over `Spec L` (`affineQuotientPullbackIso`, Speiser descent) together with the
625	universal `T`-points property `Hom_K(T, Spec A^Γ) ≅ Hom_L(T_L, Spec A)^Γ` for
626	**all** schemes `T` (affine case via `affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv`, globalized by
627	gluing along an affine open cover of `T`). -/
628	theorem isGaloisQuotient_spec :
629	    IsGaloisQuotient (specSemilinearGalAction K L A)
630	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)))) :=
631	  ⟨affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A, affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom_specMap K L A,
632	    isEquivariant_affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom K L A,
633	    affineQuotient_existsUnique K L A⟩

10	/-!
11	# The Čech Picard class of a gluing cocycle (DAT-1, stage 1e — the class law)
12	
13	The class law of `informal/spec-dat-1.md` stage (1e): a gluing cocycle on pieces
14	`U : J → X.Opens` determines a class in the definitional Picard group
15	`Scheme.CechPic` on every pointed cover subordinated to the pieces, independently of
16	the subordination; for the pinned basic-open cocycle datum the pieces cover the
17	relative curve, giving **the** class of the datum, natural in the test ring.
18	
19	* `AlgebraicGeometry.gluedSubordCocycle` — the unit Čech 1-cocycle induced on a
20	  pointed cover `𝒲` subordinated to the pieces (`σ : X → J`,
21	  `hσ : 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)`): pair values the restricted transition units.
22	* `gluedSubordCocycle_class_eq` — **subordination independence**: any two subordinated
23	  pointed covers give the same `CechPic` class (restrict to the common refinement; the
24	  two restricted cocycles are cohomologous through the `0`-cochain
25	  `x ↦ g (σ' x) (σ x)`, by the cocycle law).
26	* `gluedSubordCocycle_isCohomologous_of_coboundary` — cohomologous gluing cocycles
27	  (`Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary`) induce cohomologous subordinated cocycles, hence equal
28	  classes (`gluedSubordCocycle_class_eq_of_coboundary`) — the class-level face of the
29	  landed sheaf-level transport `gluedSheafCongr`.
30	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.cechPicClass` — the class of the pinned datum (worksheet
31	  §3.2), on the canonical pointed cover by pieces; `cechPicClass_eq_mk` re-expresses it
32	  on **any** subordinated pointed cover (the interface the stage-(1f) extraction and
33	  DAT-3 consume).
34	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.cechPicClass_baseChange` — **naturality in the test ring**:
35	  the class of the base-changed datum is the `CechPic.map`-pullback of the class along
36	  `relCurveMap C B B'`.
37	-/
38	
39	set_option autoImplicit false

41	`(C ⊗ overSpec k B).left`; see `AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeSectionsLinear`. -/
42	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

51	/-! ## The subordinated unit cocycle of a gluing cocycle -/
52	
53	section Subord
54	
55	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {J : Type u} {U : J → X.Opens}
56	variable {g g' : ∀ i j : J, Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ}
57	
58	/-- The underlying section of a restricted unit is the restricted underlying section. -/
59	private lemma coe_unitsRestrict {W U₀ : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U₀) (u : Γ(X, U₀)ˣ) :
60	    (X.unitsRestrict h u : Γ(X, W)) = X.resHom h (u : Γ(X, U₀)) :=
61	  rfl
62	
63	/-- The pair value of the subordinated cocycle: the transition unit `g (σ x) (σ y)`
64	restricted to the overlap `𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y` of the subordinated cover. -/
65	noncomputable def gluedSubordUnit (g : ∀ i j : J, Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ) (𝒲 : X.PointedCover)
66	    (σ : X → J) (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)) (x y : X) :
67	    Γ(X, 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y)ˣ :=
68	  X.unitsRestrict
69	    (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ x)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)) :
70	      𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ≤ U (σ x) ⊓ U (σ y))
71	    (g (σ x) (σ y))
72	
73	/-- The cocycle identity for the subordinated pair values, in unit-section language
74	(the shape `PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle.ofPairs` consumes). -/
75	lemma gluedSubordUnit_trans (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (𝒲 : X.PointedCover)
76	    (σ : X → J) (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)) (x y z : X) :
77	    X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left :
78	          𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens z ≤ 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y)
79	        (gluedSubordUnit g 𝒲 σ hσ x y)
80	      * X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_right :
81	          𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens z ≤ 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens z)
82	          (gluedSubordUnit g 𝒲 σ hσ y z)
83	      = X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_left :
84	          𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens z ≤ 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens z)
85	          (gluedSubordUnit g 𝒲 σ hσ x z) := by
86	  have hO : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens z ≤ U (σ x) ⊓ U (σ y) ⊓ U (σ z) :=
87	    le_inf (le_inf ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left).trans (hσ x))
88	      ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hσ y))) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ z))
89	  refine Units.ext ?_
90	  rw [Units.val_mul, coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict,
91	    gluedSubordUnit, gluedSubordUnit, gluedSubordUnit,
92	    coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict]
93	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
94	  exact hc.mul_res_of_le hO
95	
96	/-- **The subordinated unit Čech cocycle** of a gluing cocycle: on a pointed cover
97	subordinated to the pieces, the restricted transition units form a unit 1-cocycle. -/
98	noncomputable def gluedSubordCocycle (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)
99	    (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (σ : X → J) (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)) :
100	    X.unitsCocycle 𝒲 :=
101	  OneCocycle.ofPairs (G := X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat)
102	    (U := 𝒲.opens) (fun x y => gluedSubordUnit g 𝒲 σ hσ x y)
103	    (fun x y z => gluedSubordUnit_trans hc 𝒲 σ hσ x y z)
104	
105	@[simp]
106	lemma gluedSubordCocycle_evInf (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) (𝒲 : X.PointedCover)
107	    (σ : X → J) (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)) (x y : X) :
108	    Scheme.unitsEvInf (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ) x y =
109	      gluedSubordUnit g 𝒲 σ hσ x y :=
110	  OneCocycle.ofPairs_evInf (G := X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat)
111	    (U := 𝒲.opens) (fun x y => gluedSubordUnit g 𝒲 σ hσ x y)
112	    (fun x y z => gluedSubordUnit_trans hc 𝒲 σ hσ x y z) x y
113	
114	/-- Restricting the subordinated cocycle to a refinement gives the subordinated cocycle
115	of the refinement (with the induced subordination). -/
116	lemma gluedSubordCocycle_res (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) {𝒲' 𝒲 : X.PointedCover}
117	    (h : 𝒲' ≤ 𝒲) (σ : X → J) (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)) :
118	    (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ).res (fun x => homOfLE (h x)) =
119	      gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲' σ (fun x => (h x).trans (hσ x)) := by
120	  refine Scheme.unitsCocycle_ext fun x y => ?_
121	  rw [Scheme.res_unitsEvInf h (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ) x y,
122	    gluedSubordCocycle_evInf, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf]
123	  refine Units.ext ?_
124	  rw [coe_unitsRestrict, gluedSubordUnit, gluedSubordUnit,
125	    coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict]
126	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
127	
128	/-- **Two subordinations of the same cover give cohomologous cocycles**, through the
129	`0`-cochain `x ↦ g (σ' x) (σ x)` (the cocycle law makes the coboundary law hold). -/
130	lemma gluedSubordCocycle_isCohomologous (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)
131	    (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (σ σ' : X → J) (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x))
132	    (hσ' : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ' x)) :
133	    (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ).IsCohomologous (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ' hσ') := by
134	  refine Scheme.unitsCocycle_isCohomologous
135	    (fun x => X.unitsRestrict (le_inf (hσ' x) (hσ x) : 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ' x) ⊓ U (σ x))
136	      (g (σ' x) (σ x))) (fun x y => ?_)
137	  refine Units.ext ?_
138	  rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_mul, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf,
139	    coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, gluedSubordUnit, gluedSubordUnit,
140	    coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict]
141	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
142	  have hL : X.resHom (le_inf ((inf_le_left.trans (hσ' x)))
143	        ((inf_le_left.trans (hσ x))) :
144	        𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ≤ U (σ' x) ⊓ U (σ x)) (g (σ' x) (σ x) : Γ(X, _)) *
145	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ x)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)))
146	        (g (σ x) (σ y) : Γ(X, _)) =
147	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ' x)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)))
148	        (g (σ' x) (σ y) : Γ(X, _)) :=
149	    hc.mul_res_of_le (le_inf (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ' x))
150	      (inf_le_left.trans (hσ x))) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)))
151	  have hR : X.resHom (le_inf ((inf_le_left.trans (hσ' x)))
152	        ((inf_le_right.trans (hσ' y))) :
153	        𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ≤ U (σ' x) ⊓ U (σ' y)) (g (σ' x) (σ' y) : Γ(X, _)) *
154	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_right.trans (hσ' y)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)))
155	        (g (σ' y) (σ y) : Γ(X, _)) =
156	      X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ' x)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)))
157	        (g (σ' x) (σ y) : Γ(X, _)) :=
158	    hc.mul_res_of_le (le_inf (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ' x))
159	      (inf_le_right.trans (hσ' y))) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)))
160	  exact hL.trans hR.symm
161	
162	/-- **Subordination independence of the class**: any two pointed covers subordinated to
163	the pieces of a gluing cocycle carry the same `CechPic` class. -/
164	theorem gluedSubordCocycle_class_eq (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)
165	    (𝒲 𝒲' : X.PointedCover) (σ σ' : X → J) (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x))
166	    (hσ' : ∀ x : X, 𝒲'.opens x ≤ U (σ' x)) :
167	    Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲 (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ).class =
168	      Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲' (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲' σ' hσ').class := by
169	  refine Scheme.CechPic.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲', inf_le_left, inf_le_right, ?_⟩
170	  have h₁ : Scheme.unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲' ≤ 𝒲)
171	      (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ).class =
172	      (gluedSubordCocycle hc (𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲') σ
173	        (fun x => ((inf_le_left : 𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲' ≤ 𝒲) x).trans (hσ x))).class :=
174	    congrArg OneCocycle.class
175	      (gluedSubordCocycle_res hc (inf_le_left : 𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲' ≤ 𝒲) σ hσ)
176	  have h₂ : Scheme.unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲' ≤ 𝒲')
177	      (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲' σ' hσ').class =
178	      (gluedSubordCocycle hc (𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲') σ'
179	        (fun x => ((inf_le_right : 𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲' ≤ 𝒲') x).trans (hσ' x))).class :=
180	    congrArg OneCocycle.class
181	      (gluedSubordCocycle_res hc (inf_le_right : 𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲' ≤ 𝒲') σ' hσ')
182	  rw [h₁, h₂]
183	  exact (gluedSubordCocycle_isCohomologous hc (𝒲 ⊓ 𝒲') σ σ' _ _).class_eq
184	
185	/-- **Cohomologous gluing cocycles induce cohomologous subordinated cocycles**: a
186	gluing coboundary `c` between multiplier families restricts to a Čech coboundary
187	between the subordinated cocycles — the class-level face of the sheaf-level transport
188	`gluedSheafCongr`. -/
189	lemma gluedSubordCocycle_isCohomologous_of_coboundary (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)
190	    (hc' : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g') {c : ∀ j : J, Γ(X, U j)ˣ}
191	    (hcob : Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary U g g' c) (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (σ : X → J)
192	    (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)) :
193	    (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ).IsCohomologous (gluedSubordCocycle hc' 𝒲 σ hσ) := by
194	  refine Scheme.unitsCocycle_isCohomologous
195	    (fun x => X.unitsRestrict (hσ x) (c (σ x))) (fun x y => ?_)
196	  refine Units.ext ?_
197	  rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_mul, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf,
198	    coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, gluedSubordUnit, gluedSubordUnit,
199	    coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict]
200	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
201	  have key := congrArg
202	    (X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ x)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y)) :
203	      𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ≤ U (σ x) ⊓ U (σ y))) (hcob (σ x) (σ y))
204	  rw [map_mul, map_mul] at key
205	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
206	  exact key
207	
208	/-- Cohomologous gluing cocycles give equal `CechPic` classes on every subordinated
209	pointed cover. -/
210	theorem gluedSubordCocycle_class_eq_of_coboundary (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)
211	    (hc' : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g') {c : ∀ j : J, Γ(X, U j)ˣ}
212	    (hcob : Scheme.IsGluingCoboundary U g g' c) (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (σ : X → J)
213	    (hσ : ∀ x : X, 𝒲.opens x ≤ U (σ x)) :
214	    Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲 (gluedSubordCocycle hc 𝒲 σ hσ).class =
215	      Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲 (gluedSubordCocycle hc' 𝒲 σ hσ).class :=
216	  congrArg (Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲)
217	    (gluedSubordCocycle_isCohomologous_of_coboundary hc hc' hcob 𝒲 σ hσ).class_eq
218	
219	end Subord
